samples.hyp: Ukulinganisa amazinga okulingwa okuyimfuneko kwe-SARS-CoV-2 kuwo wonke umuntu ukuze kwenziwe ukulawulwa okungenzeka kokubhebhetheka kwesifo eLusaka, indawo ephambili yokuqhuma kwe-Zambia, kucatshangelwe abantu abangenayo imimonyo:
Ucwaningo oluqondile lokulinganisa ngemodeli yezibalo.

Isifo esisha seCoronavirus (i-COVID-19), esibangelwa yi-severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus—2 (i-SARS-CoV-2), e-Afrika siphawulwa yingxenye enkulu yabantu abangenayo imimonyo (noma abanemimonyo emincane) okucatshangwa ukuthi badlala indima ekusakazeni lokhu kuka.
Isilinganiso esinembile kanye nezinga lokutheleleka kwabantu abangenayo imimonyo kusazacaca.
Nokho, izifundo zibonisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwabo kubalulekile ekulawuleni ukudluliselwa kwe-SARS-CoV-2.

Senze imodeli yezibalo elula ye-deterministic susceptible-exposed-infectious-removed (SEIR) ukuhlola umphumela wokwahlukaniswa okusebenzayo kwabantu abane-SARS-CoV-2 abangenayo imiphumela ngokuhlolwa okubanzi ukulawula ukubhebhetheka eSifundazweni saseLusaka eZambia.

Lapha siye saqamba izimo ezimbili; (1) sicabanga ukuthi abantu abangenayo imimonyo bahlanganisa u-70% wazo zonke izimo ze-COVID-19 kanye (2) abantu abangenayo imimonyo bahlanganisa u-50% kuphela wezimo.

Ukuze kuqhathaniswe, imodeli yalinganiswa kuqala ngaphansi kokubheka ukuthi abantu abangenayo imimonyo bangatheleka ngendlela efanayo njengabantu abanesimonyo, bese kuthi kwesibili, futhi okungenzeka kakhulu, kubhekwe ukuthi abantu abangenayo imimonyo bangatheleka ngesigamu kuphela njengabantu abanesimonyo.

Kumodel ecabanga ngamacala angabonakali angu-70%, izinga lokulinga elihlala liqhubeka nsuku zonke elingaphezulu noma elingalingana nezivivinyo ezingu-7911/ abantu abangu-100 000 bekuyanele ukulawula ukubhebhetheka uma abantu abangabonakali beyingxenye kuphela yabangenayo, kuyilapho uma kufakwa ukutheleleka okulinganayo, kwakudingeka izinga lokulinga elingaphezulu noma elingalingana nezivivinyo ezingu-10028/ abantu abangu-100 000.

Ku-50% abangenayo imimonyo, amazinga okulinga ngokugcwele okungenani angu-≥ 4540 ukuhlolwa/ abantu abayi-100000 bekwanele ukulawula ukubhebhetheka kokusabalala kokubili amazinga acatshangelwayo okutheleleka kwabantu abangenayo imimonyo uma kuqathaniswa nabantu abanesimonyo.
Ingxoxo neziphetho

Imodeli yethu ibikezela ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa okusebenzayo kwezimo ze-COVID-19, kuhlanganise nabantu abangenayo imimonyo, ngokuhlolwa okubanzi kungenziwa njengendlela yokulawula ukudluliselwa kwe-SARS-Cov-2 eLusaka, eZambia, kodwa kuzoba yindleko ephakeme.
Ukuhlolwa kwabantu abaningi emadolobheni amakhulu njengase-Lusaka kungase kuvimbele ukwanda kwe-COVID-19, kodwa ingabe kuyasebenza?

Ngo-2020, amamodeli ekhompyutha abikezela ukuthi ukwanda kwe-COVID-19 emadolobheni amakhulu bekungalawulwa kangcono ngokuhlolwa kwabantu abaningi, bese kwahlukaniswa bonke labo abavivinywe ukuthi banayo.
Kodwa-ke, abacwaningi bathi le ndlela ingabiza futhi ingasebenzi kahle.
Ekuqaleni kwenhlekelele, abantu abaningi ababenesifo se-COVID-19 babengabonisi zimpawu zesifo, kodwa basabalalisa lesi sifo kwabanye.
Ezinye izifundo zikhombe ukuthi abantu abangu-50% kuya ku-80% abane-COVID-19 babengenazo izimpawu (abangenazimpawu) futhi kungenzeka ukuthi babengabangela u-40% kuya ku-70% wokutheleleka okusha.
Abacwaningi babefuna ukwazi ukuthi ukuthola nokuhlukanisa abantu abangenayo imimonyo kungabasiza yini ukulawula ukwanda kwe-COVID-19.
Babefisa futhi ukwazi ukuthi ukuhlola okubanzi, okusho ukuhlola abantu abaningi ngokungahleliwe, kuthola ngempumelelo yini abantu abangenayo imimonyo.
Abacwaningi bakhe imodeli yekhompyutha ebikezela ukuthi abantu bayeka ukuba sengozini, baqaphele, batheleleke, bahlukaniswe.
Bagxile kwedatha evela esifundazweni saseLusaka eZambia, okuyisikhungo sebhizinisi elina-airport yamazwe ngamazwe ehlala emingceleni yezwe ezimbili.

Ngenxa yokuthi izimpawu ze-COVID-19 zazibonakala zihlukahlukana ngendawo, bahlola izimo ezine, lapho amacala angu-50% noma angu-70% e-COVID-19 ayengenazo izimpawu, futhi la macala ayenokutheleleka okulinganayo noma oluphansi kakhulu kunalabo ababenazo izimpawu.
Imodeli yabacwaningi ithole ukuthi bekungenzeka ukulawula ukwanda kwe-COVID-19 ngokwenza ukuhlolwa okubanzi nangokukhipha bonke abantu abavivinywe ngokutholakala, ngisho nalabo abangenayo imimonyo.
Bathe bathi ukuze kunciphise inani elikhulu lezimangalo nge-90% kuzo zonke izimo, kwakudingeka ukuhlolwa kwabantu abangu-10% eLusaka nsuku zonke.
Baphethe futhi ukuthi uma sifuna ukugcina inani lezingozi ezintsha ze-COVID-19 lingashintshi, kwakudingeka kuhlolwe u-22% wabantu nsuku zonke.
Naphezu kokuba iZambia ibeke izindlela eziningi zokulinganisela i-COVID-19, amacala abonakala esekhuphuka.
Ukuhlolwa okubanzi kunciphisa ngempumelelo inani lamacala e-COVID-19 ngamaphesenti angu-90 edolobheni elincane e-Italy.
Kepha, ayikho izifundo zangaphambili ezibonisa ukuthi kungaba nomphumela emzini omkhulu kwenye indawo.

Qaphela ukuthi abacwaningi abazange benze ukuhlolwa okubanzi kulesifundo; kunalokho bakha imodeli ephakamisa ukuthi ukuhlolwa okubanzi kungasebenza ekuvimbeleni ukwanda kwe-COVID-19 emadolobheni amakhulu.
Kodwa-ke, baxwayisa ukuthi cishe kuyoba yiyona ibiza kakhulu.
Baphinda bathi kungase kube lula kakhulu uma kuhlanganiswa nezinye izindlela, njengokuvalwa kwezwe, ukulandelela abantu abaxhumene nomuntu onayo, kanye nokujova.
Abacwaningi baseZambia baphinda bagcizelela ukuthi amacala e-COVID-19 angenayo imiphumela abonakala ephindaphindiwe e-Afrika ngaleso sikhathi.
Ukungenzeki okuphansi kwama-polygenic score kubantu base-Afrika ngenxa yobuhlukahlukweni bezofuzo nemvelo.
Abantu base-Afrika abameleki kahle kakhulu ekuhlolweni kwe-genetic kodwa banobuningi obukhulu bokwahluka kwe-genetic futhi babhekene nokuvezwa okubanzi komkhathi emhlabeni jikelele.

Ngenxa yokuthi ukulinganiswa okuseqondweni kokubikezelwa kwe-genetic akukaqalwa ezinhlanganweni ezihlanganisa ukuhlukahluka kwe-Afrika, sibale ama-polygenic risk scores (PRS) ekuqaguleleni kulo lonke elase-Afrika nasemininingwaneni yedatha evela eNingizimu Afrika, e-Uganda, nase-UK ukuqonda kangcono ukusebenza kwemiphumela yocwaningo lwe-genetic.
Ukunemba kwe-PRS kuyaqhubeka kuthuthuka ngamaqembu ocwaningo afanayo ngokwemvelaphi kunasemifundweni engafanani ngokwemvelaphi.
Phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abavela ezinhlanganweni ezahlukene ngokwemvelaphi nangezinhlanga, sifumanisa ukuthi ukunemba kwe-PRS kuphansi kuzo zonke izici kepha kuyahlukahluka emaqenjini.
Ukwahluka kobuzwe base-Afrika kunegalelo elikhulu ekungafani kokunemba kwe-PRS kunokwahluka kwezinye izigaba ezinkulu ezicatshangelwe phakathi kwabantu base-UK nebase-Uganda.

Sikhompyuthile i-PRS ezizweni zase-Afrika esebenzisa izifundo ze-genetic ezingama-European kuphela versus ezihlukahlukene ngokwemvelaphi; ukwanda kokwahlukahluka kuvelise izinzuzo ezinkulu zokuqonda ngokunembile kokugxila kwe-hemoglobin kanye nokuqala kwamaseli egazi amhlophe, okuveza ukuguqulwa okukhulu okucebile ngokwemvelaphi ezinhlelweni ezaziwa ngokuthi zithinta isifo se-sickle cell kanye nempendulo ehambisana nokulimala, ngokulandelana.

Ukwahluka kokunemba kwe-PRS phakathi kwezizukulwane zase-Afrika ezivela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene kukhulu njengoba kunjalo phakathi kwezizukulwane zase-continental ezingaphandle kwe-Afrika, okudinga ukuqonda okuhambisanayo.
Kungani singakwazi ukubikezela ngokuqondile izifo ezivela ekuziphatheni kwezinto eziphilayo kubantu abavela e-Afrika
Abacwaningi bathi izindlela ezikhona manje ezisetshenziswa ukuqikelela ukuthi umuntu uzophuka yini isifo esitholakala nge-genetic ayisebenzi kahle kubantu abavela e-Afrika.
Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi idatha bese ibhukwana eliyisisekelo sezibikezelo ezinjalo ikakhulukazi lichaza i-jini labantu abavela eYurophu.
I-GWAS database imele "Genome-Wide Association Studies", futhi ososayensi bayisebenzisa ukuthi bafune izimpawu nezifo eziqondene ne-gene.
Eqinisweni, bangasebenzisa i-GWAS ukubala ingozi yezofuzo yomuntu yesifo noma uphawu.
Kodwa-ke, iningi lemininingwane ye-gene ku-GWAS livela kubantu abavela eYurophu.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukubona ukuthi ukubala abakusebenzisayo ukuthola ingozi yesifo se-genetic usebenzayo kangakanani kubantu abavela e-Afrika.
Babefisa futhi ukubona ukuthi i-GWAS ehlukahlukene kakhulu, ngamanye amazwi idatha yasebhukwini ehlanganisa ulwazi olukhulu lwezakhiwo ze-jeni zase-Afrika, ingaluthuthukisa yini uqikelelo.
Lokhu kubalwa kuwaziwa ngamagama esayensi njenge-“polygenic risk score”, noma i-PRS.

Basebenzise ama-computer ukubala ingozi elikhulukazi elikhombiswayo le-genetic kubantu base-Afrika basebenzisa i-GWAS, futhi basebenzise amarekhodi ezempilo abantu base-Afrika ukubuka izici ezithile noma izifo ezingase zibe zibangelwe ukuguqulwa kwe-jini.

Lapho basebenzisa i-European GWAS, bathole ukuthi izinga lobungozi oluvela ku-genetic lalingenamphutha kakhulu uma abantu bebenesizwe saseYurophu uma kuqhathaniswa nesizwe sase-Afrika ezintweni eziningi.
Bathe bathi amaphuzuengozi aphansi kakhulu phakathi kwezindawo zase-Afrika ngoba kunobuningi obukhulu bokwahluka phakathi kwabantu, okungafani nalokho esikubonayo ngokuzalwa kwaseYurophu.
Baphinda bathi ukunemba kwe-PRS kukhula njengoba imvelaphi yase-Afrika iyancipha.
Abantu base-Ethiopia babe neziprofetho ezinhle zezifo ezivela ekuziphatheni, ngoba bafana kakhulu ngokuziphatha nabantu baseYurophu.
Uma kusetshenziswa i-GWAS ehlukahlukene kakhulu ehlanganisa abantu abavela e-Afrika, ukunemba kokubikezela kuye kwathuthuka.
Ukubikezela izifo zegazi kwakuqondile ngokukhethekile.
Ucwaningo oluthile selubonise ukuthi i-PRS iphansi kubantu base-Afrika, okusho ukuthi idatha yase-GWAS ibikezela ingozi ephansi yezifo ezivela ekuziphatheni kwe-genetic kubantu abavela e-Afrika.
Kepha siyazi ukuthi lokhu akuyona inhliziyo.

Ucwaningo luchaza ukuthi lezi zigaba eziphansi zengozi yesifo ezivela ku-gene zingenxa yokuthi ama-gene ase-Afrika awameleki kahle kwedatha yase-GWAS, ngakho-ke amanani wamanje e-PRS awasizi ngempela ekubikezeleni izifo ezivela ku-gene e-Afrika.
Abacwaningi bathi kungcono ukusebenzisa idatha bese ihlukahlukene ebandakanya ulwazi oluvela kubantu abavela e-Afrika.

Ngakho-ke, kuyadingeka umsebenzi owengeziwe ukuze kuhlukahlukaniswe i-GWAS ukuze kuhlanganiswe izizukulwane zase-Afrika ukuze sikwazi ukubikezela ngokuqondile ingozi yezifo ezivela ekuzalaneni kubantu base-Afrika.
Ababhali balolu cwaningo bevela e-Afrika, e-USA nase-UK.
Ukulinganisa Ukuhlolwa Kwezithombe Nezokuhlukaniswa Kwezeseli Ekuphepheni I-Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia Ne-Cancer Ye-Cervix eNamibia
Kubalelwa ukuthi abesifazane abangama-851 340 eNamibia baphazanyiswe yi-human papilloma viral (HPV) infection engase ibe yimbangela yomdlavuza wesibeletho.
Ukuhlola ngeso lengqondo nge-acetic acid (VIA) kanye ne-cryotherapy kuye kwabonakala kusebenza kakhulu.
Kodwa-ke, amanani axhunyaniswe nethonya lemihlahlandlela yokuhlola umdlavuza wesibeletho awanele.
Lolu cwaningo luhlolwe ukuhlola ngeso lengqondo nokuhlola nge-cytology ekunqobeni izifo ze-cervical intraepithelial lesions (CIN) nomdlavuza we-cervix eNamibia.
Okutholakele kukhombisile ukuthi abesifazane abane-HPV, i-cervicitis, i-koilocytosis ne-atypia baphazanyiswe kakhulu yi-VIA.
Abesifazane abadala, ikakhulukazi abanayo i-HIV, banesilinganiso esiphezulu sokuxilongwa nge-squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).

I-VIA ibonakala iyindlela efanele ekusheleleni, nakuba ukusetshenziswa kwe-colposcopy ekulandeleleni iziguli endaweni yaseNamibia kufanele kuqwalaselwe futhi kusetshenziswe ngemiphumela emihle ye-HR-HPV.
Kunconywa izindlela zokuhlola ezihlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwe-HPV kubantu bezingqondo ezahlukene kanye nabantu abasezingozini (um., abane-HIV, abanesifo sokuziphatha komzimba).

Ukuthuthukiswa kokutholakala kokuhlola kungathuthukiswa nakakhulu ngezinhlelo zokusebenzisana ezisebenzisa imodeli esebenzisa imiphumela yokuxilongwa yangaphambili, imigomo yempilo yabesifazane, ulwazi olusha kanye nokuqeqeshwa okuhambisana nesimo sezinto sikazwelonke.
Abesifazane baseNamibia abasezingozini yomdlavuza wesibeletho kufanele bahlolwe futhi baphathwe ngokushesha.
Ivivinyo eziningi zingabonisa ingozi yomdlavuza wesibeletho kwabesifazane, kodwa ukuhlolwa okuvamile eNamibia akuwasebenzisi njalo le mivivinyo.
Abacwaningi bacebisa ukuhlolwa njalo, ukuthola izimpawu zokuqala, kungavimbela abesifazane ekukhuleni kuleli gciwane elibulawayo.
Umgogodla womlomo wesbele (umdlavuza wezingxenye eziphansi zesbele) ubanga ukufa okuningi kwabesifazane emhlabeni jikelele.
Esinye sezizathu ezivame kakhulu zomdlavuza wesibeletho yi-Human Papillomavirus, noma i-HPV.
I-HPV iwuvayirasi olulimaza amangqamuzana esibeletho, lukhahlela izilonda ebizwa ngokuthi yi-lesions, ezingagcina ziba yomdlavuza.
Nakuba kukhona isifo sokuvikela i-HPV, abesifazane abaningi emazweni ase-Afrika, kuhlanganise neNamibia, abanaso.
Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuhlola i-virus noma izilonda eziyibangelayo kubaluleke kakhulu kulaba besifazane, ngoba yindlela engcono kakhulu yokusiza ukuvimbela umdlavuza.
Abacwaningi kulolu cwaningo bathi ngakho izibhedlela zidinga imiyalelo efanele nolwazi mayelana nezivivinyo ezinhle kakhulu okumele zisetshenziswe.
Bengeza ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo nabo badinga ulwazi oluthe xaxa mayelana nendlela izinto ezinjengobudala noma impilo eziphazamisa ingozi yomfazi yokuthola i-HPV nomdlavuza.
Bahlolisise ukuthi zisebenza kangakanani izinhlobo ezithile zezivivinyo (ezibizwa ngokuthi izindlela zokuhlola) ekutholeni i-HPV neziphango.
Babebuye bafune ukuqhathanisa izindlela zokuhlola, ngokwesibonelo ukuqoqa amangqamuzana esibelethweni ukuhlola ukulimala uma kuqathaniswa nokuqala nje ukubuka izilonda.
Babefisa futhi ukwazi ukuthi umehluko phakathi kwabesifazane, njengobudala babo, noma ngabe babe nezinye izifo ezinjenge-HIV, bashintshe yini amathuba abo okuthola i-HPV nomdlavuza.
Ukuba nalolu lwazi kungasiza izibhedlela nama-clinic ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ngokuphumelelayo.
Abacwaningi bahlole amarekhodi eziguli abesifazane abangu-214 ababehlolwe futhi baphathwe nge-HPV, izilonda, nomdlavuza wesibeletho esibhedlela eWindhoek, eNamibia.
Bagxile ngokukhethekile ekansini yomphimbo yesigaba sokuqala, lapho isifo singaphathwa kalula futhi ngokuphumelelayo.
Baphathe futhi ulwazi mayelana nobudala bomfazi ngamunye, nempilo yakhe jikelele.

Ngokuhlola lezi zikhalazo, bathole ukuthi izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlola zivame ukunika abasebenzi bezempilo ulwazi oluhlukile, nokuthi zingase zibe usizo kakhulu ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuthi i-HPV ibe yomdlavuza.
Isibonelo, umdlavuza wawuvame ukutholakala ngokuqoqa nokucubungula amangqamuzana esibeletho.
Kodwa-ke, izilonda zazivame ukubonakala ngokuhlola nje ngamehlo, kusetshenziswa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi “ukuhlola ngamehlo nge-acetic acid” (VIA).
Inzuzo yale ndlela iwukuthi ivumela odokotela ukuthi bathole izilonda ngokushesha nangokubiza okuncane.

Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi usebenzisa imishini yemithi eyisisekelo eseseyisetshenziswa ekuhlolweni kwabesifazane kwezitho zangasese, njengesipikili (ithuluzi elenziwe ngensimbi elisetshenziswa ukubuka ngaphakathi kwesikhumba).
Baphethe futhi ukuthi ukuhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene kuvame ukunika odokotela ulwazi oluningi mayelana nengozi yomfazi yokuthola umdlavuza, ikakhulukazi ngokuhlolwa okuningi.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abesifazane abadala, ikakhulukazi labo abanayo i-HIV, banokutholakala beba ne-kansa, ngakho ukuhlola njalo kungaba kubaluleke kakhulu.
Abacwaningi benezela ukuthi abesifazane abambalwa kakhulu abahlolwe yi-HPV (ngaphambi kokubheka izilonda) ngisho noma kukhona ivivi.
Ukwenza kanjalo kungaba yindlela ebalulekile yokuthola isifo ngisho nangaphambi kwesikhathi.

Ukuqeda, bathi imiphumela yabo ikhombisile isidingo sohlelo lwezempilo eNamibia lokucwangcisa amasu okuvimbela i-HPV nomdlavuza wesibeletho ngokucophelela, usebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola eziphucukile nezishibhile ukuthola lezi zifo ngokushesha okukhulu.
Ucwaningo lwaluyisivumelwano sokusebenzisana phakathi kwesayensi zaseNamibia naseNingizimu Afrika.
Inzuzo yokwelashwa ekubeni ne-HBV/HIV ndawonye uma kuqathaniswa nokuthi ube ne-HBV kuphela kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

Sinqunywe imigomo yamazwe ngamazwe yokususwa kwe-hepatitis B virus (HBV), saqala ukuqondisa abantu abane-HBV monoinfection vs. labo abane-HBV/HIV, ukuhlola umthelela wokwelashwa nokuqondisa ukuthuthukiswa kokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha.

Simemezela idatha yokubuka evela eqoqweni le-cohort eliqondile lomhlaba wangempela labantu abadala abangu-115 abane-hepatitis B ehlala njalo (CHB), esibhedlela seyunivesithi eKapa Town, eNingizimu Afrika.
Ukutheleleka okuhlangene kwe-HIV kwakukhona kubantu abangu-39 (34%).
Sibhale idatha yesigaba esiphambene yabantu, yezokwelapha neyelabhoratri.

Uma kuqathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV coinfection, abantu abadala abane-HBV monoinfection babengavamile ukuba yi-HBeAg-positive (p=0.01), babengavamile ukwenziwa ukuhlolwa nge-elastography (p<0.0001), futhi babengavamile ukuba esikhwameni sokwelapha nge-antiviral (p<0.0001); babengavamile ukuba ne-HBV viraemia ebonakalayo (p=0.04), futhi babengavamile ukuba nezici zesifo se-liver okuhlanganisa i-thrombocytopaenia ephakathi/eqatha (p=0.007), i-bilirubin ephezulu (p=0.004), kanye ne-APRI score ephezulu (p=0.02).
Izimo ezintathu ze-hepatocellular carcinoma zonke zivele ku-HBV monoinfection.

Idatha yethu ibonisa ukuthi abantu abane-HBV monoinfection bangase babe sengozini uma beqhathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV coinfection, okugcizelela ukungalingani okungenzeka kohlelo oluhleliwe ekubhekiseni, ukulandelela nokwelashwa.
Abacwaningi banikeza imiyalelo yokuthuthukisa ukwelashwa kwe-hepatitis B.

Kucwaningo lwakamuva, abacwaningi bakwazile ukugqamisa ukuthi ukutheleleka yi-hepatitis B (HBV) ne-human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) kungase kunikeze inzuzo yokwelashwa uma kuqhathaniswa nokutholakala yi-HBV kuphela.
ENingizimu Afrika, ukutheleleka okuqhubekayo kokubili yi-HBV ne-HIV kuyinkinga enkulu.
Odokotela kudingeka baqonde ukuthi lezi zinzalo kanye nezinambuzane ezisetshenziswayo ukuze ziphathwe zisebenzelana kanjani, ukuze bakwazi ukuxilonga nokukhathalela iziguli kangcono.
Abacwaningi babefuna ukuqhathanisa imiphumela yokuwelapha kwabagula ababe ne-HBV kuphela, nabagula ababe ne-HBV ne-HIV.
Kulesifundo, abacwaningi baqashwe iziguli ezindala ezingama-115 ezine-hepatitis B ehlala njalo (CHB).
Baqashwe esibhedlela iTygerberg eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika.
Abanye abagulayo babephethwe yi-HIV (39) kanti abanye babephethwe yi-HBV kuphela.
Abacwaningi babheke uhlanga, ubudala nobulili, futhi benze izivivinyo ezahlukene zezokwelapha nezelabhoratri.

Bathole ukuthi iziguli ezazine-HBV kuphela zazingavamile ukuba ngaphansi kwanoma iyiphi uhlobo lokwelashwa ngokumelene ne-viral, zibonisa izimpawu zemvelo zesifo sesibindi (njengoba i-HBV iwumkhuhlane ongase ubangela isifo esinzima sesibindi).

Abacwaningi bakwazile ukukhombisa ukuthi abantu abane-HBV kuphela babe sesimweni esibi uma beqhathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV ne-HBV, njengoba iziguli ezithintekile zombili izifo zazivame ukuba ngaphansi kokwelashwa kwe-antiviral ye-HIV, okunikeza futhi inzuzo ethile ekulweni nokuthinteka kwe-HBV.

Imiphumela yalesi sifundo ikhomba umthelela onokwenzeka wokungafani phakathi kokudlulisela, ukulandelela kanye nezinketho zokwelapha i-HBV uma kuqathaniswa ne-HIV ne-HBV coinfection, okuyisiza labo abane-HIV ne-HBV.
Abacwaningi bagcizelele ukuthi kumele sithuthukise futhi sinikeze isevisi ephephile futhi elungile kulabo abane-HBV kuphela.
Esinye isiphephelo sale ncwadi yisilinganiso esincane sabantu esasiqondene kuphela nelizwe elilodwa nezinhlelo zazo zezibhedlela.
Ezinye, mhlawumbe izindawo zezibhedlela eziphambili zingase zibonise umbono ohlukile uma kuqathaniswa nalokho okutholakele kuleli cwaningo.
Kumelwe kwenziwe izifundo eziningi ukuze kuqondwe ngempela umehluko olutholiwe kuleli sifundo.
Le ncwadi ibonise amandla okubambisana, ngabacwaningi abasebenza kuleliphrojekthi evela eNingizimu Afrika nase-United Kingdom.
Ngokuyisebenzisa inani labantu abagulayo baseNingizimu Afrika kule ncwadi, kubalulekile engxenyeni yabantu base-Afrika.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, ucwaningo lungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokwelapha ezingcono kulabo abagulayo yi-HBV, i-HIV noma zombili.
Ukuhlolwa Komthelela Wokungaphephileki Emisebenzini Yebhizinisi Labesifazane E-SHIRORO Local Government Area Yase-Niger State

Ucwaningo lolu luhlolwe umthelela wokungaphephileki emisebenzini yabantu abenza ibhizinisi ababesifazane eSifundeni sase-Shiroro eSifundazweni sase-Niger, kugxilwe ngokukhethekile ezindabeni eziphathelene nokuqinisana kwabesifazane ngokwezimali, uhlobo lwemisebenzi yabantu abenza ibhizinisi evamile phakathi kwabo kanye nobukhulu bomthelela wokungaphephileki emizameni yabo yabantu abenza ibhizinisi.

Isibonelo sabesifazane abangu-377 sihlolwe, okubangele ukutholakala kokuthi abesifazane baseShiroro banesifiso esikhulu sokwenza ibhizinisi, banobuningi bokuphila ngokuzimela kwezezimali, futhi bahlanganyela kakhulu e-SMEs.

Ucwaningo luye lwatholalokho futhi ukuthi ngenkathi ukungaphepheli kunomphumela omubi emisebenzini yabantu basebesifazane abangabaphathi bezimboni ngendlela yokulahleka noma ukwehla likaphethiloli phakathi kwezinye izinto, inani labesifazane abangabaphathi bezimboni alizange lihlupheke ngokwehla okukhulu.

Ucwaningo luncoma ukuthi kufanele kudalwe izinhlelo ezinokukhuthazela zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwabesifazane kanye nokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zezezimali, futhi kufanele futhi kudalwe futhi kuqinisiwe izinhlangano zokuqapha umphakathi ukuze zilwe nokungaphephileki endaweni yocwaningo.
Abesifazane basebenza eNiger badinga ukuphepha okwengeziwe.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abesifazane abenza ibhizinisi eNiger banesifiso esikhulu sokwenza ibhizinisi futhi bazimele ngokwezimali, kodwa ukuphepha ezigebengwini kuyinkinga.

Abacwaningi babefuna ukwazi ukuthi abesifazane abaphatha amabhizinisi e-Shiroro Local Government Area yase-Niger State baphephile kangakanani futhi baqinisekile kangakanani, nokuthi lokhu kungathinta kanjani amabhizinisi abo nokuzimela kwezezimali.
Bahlangana nabesifazane abangu-377 kule ndawo bexoxa ngezinselele ababhekana nazo ekuqaleni kwemisebenzi yabo, ukuxhomeka kwezezimali nokungakhululeki.
Baphóthule ukuthi u-43% wabesifazane bathi abazichibiseli emadodeni ngemali, futhi u-32% bathi kunabanye abantu abazichibiselisa kubo ngemali.
Abacwaningi bakwathola ukuthi u-85% wabesifazane babezuza imali emakhishini ahlukene, futhi bambalwa kuphela abathi babededelwe yimishahara.
Cishe u-56% bathole imali ngokulima, kanti u-79% ngokuhweba.
Cishe owesifazane oyedwa kwabayisihlanu uthole imali ngokuphehla izinwele, ukubuka, ukunxiba noma ukwenza izinto zokugeza.
Iningi labesifazane (91%) litshele abacwaningi ukuthi amabhizinisi abo athinteke ukwesaba kwabo ukohlaselwa amasela nezigebengu.
Balahlekelwa imali, ngisho namadoda abo ngenxa yalezi zihlaselo, ngezinye izikhathi kubaphoqa ukuba baphile bodwa nezingane zabo.
Abesifazane baphinda bathi babengenazo izakhono nemali eyanele yokwandisa amabhizinisi abo.
Abacwaningi babike ukuthi naphezu kwalelo zinga, abesifazane baseNiger baqhubeke bephumelela kakhulu emakhaya abo.
Bathe bathi eShiroro kwakukhona abantu bezizwe nezenkolo ezihlukahlukene, futhi lokhu kwakuhle nakwebhizinisi.
Ucwaningo olukhona luqhathanisa imiphumela yabacwaningi abanye ababike ukuthi abesifazane abanalo impumelelo emisebenzini ngenxa yokunakekela ekhaya.
Kunalokho, labo bacwaningi bathi impumelelo yabesifazane abenza ibhizinisi kule ndawo yaseNiger ithonya kakhulu yingozi yokuhlaselwa yizigebengu nezihlangu.
Abacwaningi baye bancoma ukuthi bonke ababambiqhaza kufanele bahlangane balwe nezinto ezingenza kube nzima ukuphumelela ekuhwebeni.
Ngokwesibonelo, abesifazane baseNiger kufanele bathole ukufinyelela okukhulu emalini, emapulazini nasekuphepheni.
Baphinda basikisela ukuthi abesifazane abasebenza emabhizinisini bangakha amaqembu azobasiza ekuqaleni nezigebengu nezihlubuki.
Amandla eSelenium, iCopper neZinc egazini likamama ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa ahlobene nezingozi zokubeletha kwangaphambi kwesikhathi okungalindelekile: Ucwaningo lwe-case-control oluvela eMalawi.
Ukukhulelwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi ukukhulelwa okwenzeka ngaphambi kwamasonto angu-37 aphelele.
Ucwaningo lwenziwe ukuhlola ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazinga e-selenium, ithusi, ne-zinc egazini likamama, nokuzalwa kwengane ngaphambi kwesikhathi.

Kwakukhona abesifazane abangu-181 kulolu cwaningo oluhlanganisiwe lwe-case-control, abangu-90/181 (49.7%) abakhulelwe isikhathi esigcwele kanye naba ngu-91/181 (50.3%) abakhulelwe isikhathi esingaphelelanga.

Izinga eliphelele elikathi eliphakathi le-selenium egazini lalingu-77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, ithusi lalingu-2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L kanye ne-zinc lalingu-0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L ngamanani okubhekisela angu-47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L kanye no-0.59-1.11 mg/L, ngokulandelana.
Imiphumela ikhombisa ukuthi kwakungekho ukushoda kwe-selenium, ne-zinc; kanye nokugxila okuphezulu kwe-copper yeserum ekukhulelweni.
Ukuzalwa kwengane ngaphambi kwesikhathi kuhlangene namanani aphezulu e-copper ne-zinc egazini likamama.
Amanani e-zinc, ithusi, ne-selenium ahlobene nokuzalwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi

Abacwaningi bathole ukwanda okuphezulu kwe-micronutrients i-selenium, i-copper, ne-zinc, kubesifazane abazalile ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa basaphikisana uma lokhu kuwanda okuphezulu kuvela ekudleni abakudlayo.
Ukukhulelwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi kwenzeka lapho owesifazane ebeletha ngaphambi kokuphelelwa amasonto angu-37 okukhulelwa.
Ukuzalwa kwengane ngaphambi kwesikhathi kuhlotshaniswa nemiphumela yempilo embi yengane kusukela ebuthweni bomzimba kuze kube yokufa.
Zingaba izimbangela eziningi zokubeletha kwangaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa indima yokugxila okuphezulu kwezakhamzimba ezincane ezitholakala ekudleni nasendaweni ezungezile ayaziwa kakhulu.
Lezi zondlo ezincane zibalulekile ekukhuleni komntwana, kodwa abacwaningi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi kwenzekani uma kuningi kakhulu kwazo.

Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi babeqonde ukulinganisa amazinga e-selenium, ithusi, ne-zinc kubesifazane ababenamabele okubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi, bese beqonde ukuthola amathuba okuba ukubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi kubangelwa amazinga aphezulu alezo zondlo ezincane ezifundwe.
Abacwaningi baqoqe amasampula egazi kwabesifazane abangu-181 ngokushesha nje ngemva kokubeletha ezigulini ezimbili eLilongwe, inhloko-dolobha yaseMalawi, phakathi kukaJuni 2016 noMashi 2017.
Bathumela amasampula egazi elabhoratri eNorway lapho bakhipha khona i-serum, uhlobo oluhlanzekile lwegazi, balinganise amazinga e-selenium, ithusi ne-zinc.
Cishe ingxenye yabesifazane abangu-181 ababenesifundo babe nezinsana ezingazalwanga isikhathi, futhi abacwaningi bathole amazinga aphezulu kakhulu e-selenium, ithusi ne-zinc.

Bese balungisa izibalo zabo ukuze kubhekwe ezinye izinto eziningi ezifana nobudala, impilo jikelele, kanye nomlando wokukhulelwa ukuze kuvezwe imiphumela ecingelwayo yezakhamzimba ezincane ekubeni khona kokubeletha kwangaphambi kwesikhathi.

Baphetha ngokuthi amazinga amakhulu e-selenium ne-copper awazange adlale indima ebalulekile ekubeni imbuyiselo yengane ibe yisikhathi esingakapheli, kodwa ukuthi amazinga aphezulu e-zinc kwandisa ingozi yokubeletha kwangaphambi kwesikhathi ngaphezu kwesikhathi esi-6.
Kodwa-ke, inani elikhulu lethusi laliyinkathazo kubacwaningi, ngenxa yemiphumela eyingozi eyaaziwayo.

Ukuba nabesifazane abangu-181 kuphela ababehileleke ocwaningweni kuye kwakhawulela ikhono labo cwaningi lokufumana ngokufanele izingozi ezihambisana namanani aphezulu e-selenium, njengoba inani elifanele lababamba iqhaza lingama-600.
Ukudla kwansuku zonke kwabahlanganyeli akuphenyiwanga ukuze kutholakale imithombo engenzeka yezakhamzimba ezintathu, futhi i-Body Mass Index (BMI) yabo ayirekhodiwanga.
Lona ngumsebenzi wokuqala woluhlobo olulinganisa imiphumela ye-selenium, ithusi ne-zinc kubesifazane abakhulelwe eMalawi.

IAfrika inezinani eziphezulu kakhulu zokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi - ngaphezu kuka-18% uma kuqhathaniswa namazwe aseNtshonalanga angu-5%, ngakho-ke abacwaningi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi ukudla kudlala indima.
Ukuphatha Kwekhaya, Ukuzinikela Kwendawonye Nokubusa Kwezwe Le-Pancake tortoise (Malacochersus tornieri) eKenya
Izilwane zibonisa ukuziphatha okuhlukile ngokwesikhala nesikhathi okwandisa ukuphila kwazo.
Ukuqonda le miqondo kubalulekile ekuqalisweni kokulondolozwa nokulawulwa okuphumelelayo ikakhulukazi kwezinhlobo ezisengozini.

Kulesifundo, sihlaziye ukuthi ingabe i-Pancake tortoise inekhono lokubuyela ekhaya uma ithuthelwe kwenye indawo, futhi saqalaza nokwethembeka kwendawo kanye nokuhlala kwesizinda salesi sihlobo ezindaweni zaso zemvelo eKitui County, eKenya.

Ukuziphatha kwezilwane ezingama-39 zezilwane ezineqanda ezihlala ezikhefini zamatshe ezihlukene ngendawo eziyi-12 kwafundwa kusukela ngoJulayi 2020 kuya kuJuni 2022 ngokulandelela ngomsakazo, ukubopha ikhamera kanye nokuhlanganiswa kokuhlola amasampula ezingqikithi kanye ne-ad libitum sampling.
Ezine (14) zezilwane ezinqolobane zafakwa ama-radio-transmitters, zathuthelwa emaphethelweni ahlukile kude namaphethelwe azo asekhaya, futhi ukuhamba kwazo nokuziphatha kwazo kwakulandelelwa.

Ngaphandle kwabesifazane ababili kuphela abazizolise kahle ezikhaleni ezintsha zokuthuthela, wonke amanye ama-tortoise azame ukubuyela ekhaya, nge-46.15% kuwo elandela indlela yabo ebuyela ezikhaleni zawo zasekhaya ngenkambo eqondile ne-15.38% efika nasezindaweni ezikholelwa ukuthi zisezingeni lasekhaya lawo.
Ukubuyela ekhaya okuphumelelayo ngokuqinisekile kubonisa ubuqotho obukhulu bendawo kulolu hlobo.

Ukuhlaziywa kokutholakala kwezikhewu zezilwane zasehlathini kukhombisile ukuthi bekungekho umehluko obalulekile ngokwezibalo phakathi kwenani lezilwane zasehlathini ezazikhona ekuqaleni ezikhewu kanye nenani eliphakathi elikhona ezinsukwini ezingama-162 zokuhlola (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P > 0.05), okuqhubeka nokusekela ukuthembeka okukhulu kwendawo kule nhlobo.

Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izehlakalo zokubamba ngekhamera kanye nokukhetha okukhulu kwabonisa nokuthi izilwane zasePancake ziyindawo yazo, ngamadoda alwa ngokubulala ukuvikela izindawo zawo kwabanye amadoda afika.
Izilwane zasehlathini ezihlala zilahleka zinobukhulu obukhulu ‘bokubuyela ekhaya’.

Abacwaningi benze ukutholakala okumangalisayo ngesikhathi becwaninga ukuziphatha kwezilwane zase-Afrika eseMpumalanga ezingama-pancake tortoise (Malacochersus tornieri): lezi zilwane zingakwazi ukuthola indlela yazo ebuya ekhaya ngemva kokuthuthelwa ibanga elide.
Ukuqonda ukuthi benza kanjani lokhu nokuthi kungani benza kanjalo kungaba kubalulekile ekulondolozeni lezi zinyoka ezingavamile.
Ukuziphatha kokufuna ikhaya lezi zinkombazana ezikubonisa kubizwa ngokuthi “ukubuyela ekhaya”, futhi ezinye izilwane eziningi zingakwenza lokho.
Ukukwazi ukubuyela ezindaweni ezithile kuvumela izilwane ukuba zibuyele ekudleni, kubalingani, nasezikhumbulweni, okwenza kube lula ukuthi zisinde futhi zizale.

Nakuba ukuphindela endlini kwafundwa ezikhwameni zolwandle nezamanzi amnandi, abacwaningi kulolu cwaningo bathi sazi kancane kakhulu ngokuphindela endlini kwezinkamba (ezifanayo nezikhwame emhlabathini).
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuqonda okwengeziwe ngokuziphatha kwezilwane zase-pancake tortoise emakhaya azo eKenya, ezindaweni ezinamatshe.
Babafunda izilwane njengoba zikuhamba zidla, futhi nakuba ziya ekuphumuleni emaphethelweni, noma emaphethiniwe emibhedeni.
Abacwaningi baqaphele amaqembu ezikhukhula ze-pancake cishe iminyaka emibili, futhi babekela amakhamera ukuqopha amavidiyo ezilwane lapho bengabakqapheli.
Baphinkelela futhi abathumeli berediyo kuma-tortoise angu-14.
Lezi yizinto ezincane ezinika abacwaningi amandla okulandelela ukuhamba kwezilwane, nokubheka ukuthi zichitha isikhathi kuphi emini nasebusuku.
Abacwaningi base behlisa amanye alawa akhonjwa ezindaweni ezintsha, ukuze bakwazi ukuwafunda kalula.
Kepha, kwakuyisimangaliso kubaphenyi, izinqola ezimbili zaqala ukubuyela ezindaweni zazo zokuqala, phakathi kwa-1 no-2.5 km ukusuka lapho bezihambiswe khona.
Yilapho abacwaningi banquma khona ukuzama ukuhambisa izilwane eziningi ezikude namakhaya azo, ukuze babone ukuthi zizobonisa yini ukuziphatha okufanayo “kokuphendukela ekhaya”.

Kuyathakazelisa ukuthi, cishe ingxenye yeningi lezikhukhula zaphumelela ukubuyela ezikhefini ezifanayo ezazihlala kuzo ngaphambi kokuba zihanjiswe, zivame ukuhamba ibanga elingaphezu kwe-1.5 km ukuze zifike lapho.
Abanye abangu-15% babo bakwazile ukubuyela endaweni ephakathi, kodwa abazange bakwazi ukuthola i-crevice ababethathiwe kuyo ekuqaleni.

Abacwaningi bakuthola futhi ukuthi ama-crevice ahlukene ngokuvamile ayenani elifanayo lezikhukhula eziphumule kuwo, okuphakamisa ukuthi izikhukhula zihlala zisebenzisa izindawo ezifanayo ukuze ziphumule.
Izithombe ezivela kumakhamera nazo zibonise ukuthi izigqokokazi ezizinduna zazinendawo yazo, okusho ukuthi zazilwa nezinye izinduna ezazifuna ukungena endaweni yazo noma eceleni.

Abacwaningi bathi lokhu kuyisikhathi sokuqala ukubonwa kokuziphatha kokubuyela ekhaya ezikhonkwane ze-pancake, nokuthi imiphumela yabo ikhombisa ukuthi lezi zilwane zikhetha ukuhlala nokupumula ezindaweni ezifanayo noma nini lapho zingakwazi.
Ucwaningo lwabo aluzange luchaze ukuthi izigqikithi zazithola kanjani indlela yazo emakhaya, ngakho-ke ucwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo kufanele lugxile ekuqondeni leli qophelo elibalulekile.
Ngenxa yokuthi izilwane ngezinye izikhathi kudingeka zisuswe ziye ezindaweni ezintsha zokulondolozwa, lolu lwazi lungabasiza abalondolozi ukuba bagcine izigqoko ziphephile endlini yazo entsha.
Ucwaningo lwaluyisivumelwano phakathi kwesayensi evela eKenya naseChina, futhi lwanezela olwazini lwethu ngokuziphatha kokubuyela ekhaya kwezilwane ezinyoka nezinye izilwane.
I-Pharmacokinetics ye-Plasma ye-Rifampicin enkulu ngomlomo ne-Intravenous kubantu abane-Tuberculous Meningitis:
Ivivinyo Elingahlelekile Ngokungahlelekile
Amanani aphezulu e-rifampicin eyenziwa nge-intravenous angathuthukisa imiphumela ekwelapheni i-tuberculous meningitis kodwa awasebenzi kahle ezindaweni lapho kukhona khona izifo eziningi.

Siqagase ukuthi ukukhishwa kwe-rifampicin yeplasma kuzofanana phakathi kokunikezwa komlomo kwama-35 mg/kg wesisindo somzimba kanye nokufakwa kwe-intravenous kwama-20 mg/kg, okuye kwaphakanyiswa ezilingweni zokusebenza kahle kwesifo se-tuberculous meningitis.
Senze ucwaningo lwe-pharmacokinetic oluhleliwe ngokuhlanganyela kweqembu, olufakwe ngaphakathi kocwaningo lwezokwelapha lokwelashwa okuqiniswe kokulwa nezifo eziyimikrofoni ye-tuberculous meningitis.
Abahlanganyeli abane-HIV abanesifo sokuvuvukala kwengqondo ngenxa ye-tuberculosis baqokwa ezigulini zaseNingizimu Afrika, bahlukaniswe ngokungahleliwe emaqunwini amathathu okunikezwa kwe-rifampicin:
esinye (sokumathwa, 10 mg/kg), esiphezulu (sokumathwa, 35 mg/kg), kanye ne-intravenous (20 mg/kg).
Ukuqoqwa okuningi kwe-pharmacokinetic kwenziwe ngosuku lwesithathu.
Imininingwane ichazwe ngokusebenzisa ukuhlaziywa okungekho ngama-compartment, futhi ukukhishwa kuqhathaniswe ngama-geometric mean ratios (GMRs).
Ababambiqhaza abangamashumi amane nesithupha bafake isibonelo se-pharmacokinetic (umthamo ojwayelekile, n = 17; umthamo ophezulu ngomlomo, n = 15; nge-intravenous, n = 14).
Inani eliphakathi le-CD4 lalingamaseli angu-130/mm3 (ububanzi phakathi kwekota [IQR], amaseli angu-66 kuya kwangu-253/mm3).

Amanani e-rifampicin geometric mean area under the concentration-time curve kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-24 h (AUC0–24) ayengama-42.9mg · h/ml (isiphambeko sokuthembela kwe-95% [CI], 24.5 kuya ku-75.0mg ·h/ml) ngenani elijwayelekile, 295.2mg · h/ml (isiphambeko sokuthembela kwe-95% [CI], 189.9 kuya ku-458.8mg · h/ml) ngenani eliphezulu lomlomo, kanye nama-206.5mg · h/ml (isiphambeko sokuthembela kwe-95% [CI], 154.6 kuya ku-275.8mg · h/ml) ngokuphathwa nge-intravenous.

I-GMR ye-rifampicin AUC0–24 yayingu-1.44 (90% CI, 0.84 kuya ku-2.21) kanti i-GMR yekhonsathresheni enkulu yemithi e-serum (Cmax) yayingu-0.89 (90% CI, 0.63 kuya ku-1.23) ngokuphathelene nokuphathwa nge-intravenous ngokusebenzisa umlomo onamandla.

I-AUC0–24 yeplasma ye-rifampicin yayiphezulu ngemva kokuthatha umthamo wemlomo ongu-35 mg/kg kunokunikezwa nge-intravenous ngomthamo ongu-20 mg/kg ezinsukwini ezimbalwa zokuqala zokwelashwa isifo sohlanga (TB).
Imiphumela isekela ukunikezwa komlomo kwe-rifampicin ezivivinyweni ze-tuberculous meningitis zesikhathi esizayo.
Amaphilisi omthamo ophezulu angalingwa kubantu abane-HIV abanephthisi yengqondo.
Abacwaningi baye baqinisekisa ukuthi kubalulekile ukuqala ukuhlola ukuthi izilinganiso eziphezulu zomuthi i-rifampicin zingabasindisa yini iziguli ze-HIV ezine-tuberculosis meningitis.
Abantu abangafika kwaba-3 kwaba-5 abane-HIV abaphathwa yi-tuberculosis meningitis bafa ngenxa yalesi sifo, esihlasela uhlelo lwezinzwa.
Abasindile bavame ukushiywa benenkinga ehlala njalo ohlelweni lwabo oluphakathi lwemisipha kanye nezinzwa ezibalulekile ezivela ebuchosheni.
Lokhu kungathinta imizwelo yabo nokuhamba kwabo.
Abanye abagulayo baba nokuhluleka komzimba noma isihlabathi, noma izingxenye zobuso babo noma umzimba wabo ziyaba buthakathaka.
I-Rifampicin, iyeza elikhulu lokulwa nezifo elibulala amagciwane, liqhelekile linikezwa ngama-capsules ukuzama ukubulala amagciwane abangela isifo sokuvuvukala kwengqondo.
Abagulayo kakhulu bavame ukubona kunzima ukugwinya amaphilisi.
I-Rifampicin ingaphinda inikezwe nge-intravenously (emithanjeni) ngesimo esilukhuni.
Khona-ke, isibopho sifakwa emithanjeni yomuntu ogula ukuze leyo ncibiliko ikwazi ukukhishwa emzimbeni.
Akukaqalwa lutho ukuhlola ukuthi umzimba womuntu uthatha kanjani le mithi uma le ndlela isebenza.
Ukwelashwa nge-intravenous kudinga imishini eminingi, ukungena esibhedlela nomsebenzi wezempilo oqeqeshwe owazi ukuthi angayifaka kanjani i-needle ye-intravenous ngendlela efanele.
Ngakho-ke akuyona indlela eqondile ezindaweni ezinqanyuliwe zezwe.
Odokotela sebevele bayazi ukuthi i-rifampicin ayithathwa kahle yi-fluid ebuchosheni, e-spine nasekhanda, lapho ama-bacteria angafihla khona.
Kungakho kudingeka amazinga aphezulu (amanani) ukuze kubulawe ngempumelelo bonke amabhaktheriya emzimbeni womuntu.
Kodwa abacwaningi babengabaza ukuthi umthamo ophakeme kangakanani ungaba nomphumela futhi ukhulu.

Abacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika ne-United Kingdom ngaleyondlela bafuna ukuthola, besebenzisa inani elincane labaguli, ukuthi kuphephile yini ukunika imithamo ephakeme ye-rifampicin noma njenge-capsules noma nge-intravenously, nokuthi imizimba yabo izoyithatha kanjani inguqulo ngayinye.
Kubalulekile ukwazi lokhu ngaphambi kokuba abacwaningi abanye baqale ngezivavanyo ezinkulu, noma ukuhlolwa, lapho bahlela ukunika iziguli eziningi kakhulu izilinganiso eziphezulu ze-rifampicin.
Omunye wemikhakha emithathu yokwelashwa nge-rifampicin unikezwe iziguli zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingama-46 ezine-HIV ezine-tuberculous meningitis.
Okokuqala kwakuwukwelashwa okujwayelekile kwamakhaphsuli anikezwa abagulayo njengamanje, okubalwa ku-10mg ye-rifampicin ngekhilogremu ngayinye isisindo somguli.
Enye iqembu yathola ama-capsule aphezulu angu-35 milligrams ngekhilogremu yesisindo somuntu.
Iqembu lesithathu lamukela ama-milligram angu-20 ngekhilogremu yesisindo somuntu nge-intravenously.
Izi sampuli zegazi zithathwe kubantu abagulayo ngemva kwezinsuku ezintathu.
Abacwaningi base bekeqela ukuthi kungakanani i-rifampicin elikhona e-plasma yegazi labo (ingxenye eyi-liquid yegazi).
Kutholakale i-rifampicin eningi emizimbeni yabantu abaphathwe ngama-capsules omthamo ophezulu kunalabo abaphathwe ngokwelashwa nge-intravenous noma umthamo ojwayelekile.
Ubuningi bomuthi e-plasma yegazi babuhlangana kokubili ekwelapheni okuphezulu nokwesinyathelo.
Lezi zingxube zaziyinkulu kunezikhathi lapho iziguli zithola kuphela umthamo ojwayelekile.
Ngokusho lwabacwaningi, lokhu kubonisa ukuthi impilo yabagula nge-tuberculosis meningitis ingathuthukiswa uma bethatha imithamo ephakeme ye-rifampicin.

Akuyona into ebalulekile ukuthi bayithola njengezithoqo noma nge-intravenously - okubalulekile ukuthi bathole izilinganiso eziphezulu, ngoba imizimba yabo iyokwazi ukugcina ukugxila okuphezulu kwakho.
Imiphumela isekela okutholakele ezivivinyweni ezenziwe e-Uganda nase-Indonesia.
Izivivinyo ezincane ezimbili e-Indonesia, isibonelo, zikhombe ukuthi ukuphila kwabaguli abaningi kakhulu kungasindiswa uma benikezwa imithamo ephakeme ye-rifampicin ngomlomo noma nge-intravenously.
Kodwa-ke, abacwaningi bayaxwayisa ukuthi ababambiqhaza abambalwa abaye baba khona kulolu cwaningo kunalokho ababekuqale bekuthanda, okungase kulimale imiphumela yabo.
Ucwaningo lwenziwe eNingizimu Afrika.
Lusekela uhlelo lokwenza amavivinyo ukuhlola ukuthi kuyabafanele yini ukunika iziguli ze-HIV ezine-tuberculosis meningitis imithamo emikhulu ye-rifampicin.
Kulindeleke ukuthi ukwelashwa okunjalo kuzosindisa izimpilo eziningi zabantu e-Afrika nakwezinye izindawo zezwe lapho isifo sohlwempu lwe-tuberculosis siyimbangela enkulu yengxaki.
Ukusetshenziswa kanye komanyolo kanye ne-biochar kungayithuthukisa yini ikhwalithi yomhlabathi wasehlathini laselwandle oqhekekile kakhulu?
Ukuncipha kokunisela komhlabathi kuyinkinga enkulu ekukhiqizweni kwezitshalo e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara.
Imiphumela emihle yokusebenzisa i-biochar kanye ne-compost ekuhlonyeni komhlabathi ibikwe ababhali abaningi.

Kulesifundo, kwakwenziwa i-incubation yesikhathi esingama-30 e-laboratory usebenzisa amasampula angu-120 g ngalinye le-Haplic acrisol ehlanganiswe ne-corn cob biochar (cbio), i-rice husk biochar (rbio), i-coconut husk biochar (coco300 ne-coco700) noma i-compost yomquba wezinkukhu (compost); kanye ne-rice husk biochar ehlanganisiwe (rcocomp) noma i-corn cob biochar ehlanganisiwe (cococomp) ngezilinganiso ze-1% w/w amendment: umhlabathi, ngokulandelana.

Ezinye izindlela zokwelapha ekutadishweni kwakuhlanganiswe ukombandlela oluhlanganisiwe lwenkukhu kanye ne-biochar yekhobho yekhomu noma i-biochar yeqanda lerayisi (1% ukombandlela + 1% biochar: 1% umhlabathi w/w), ngokulandelana, ukuhlola imiphumela yazo ekuphefumuleni komhlabathi oyisisekelo, i-pH yomhlabathi; ikhabhoni yomhlabathi; ikhono lokushintshana kwamakhethini; ikhabhoni ephelele ephilayo, nayithrogeni ephelele kanye nokugxila kwenayithrogeni etholakalayo.

U-Biochar kanye nokhumulo olusetshenziswe ngokwedwa noma ndawonye, kanye nokhumulo oluhlanganisiwe lo-biochar, lukhulise i-pH yomhlabathi ngamayunithi e-pH angu-0.28–2.29 uma kuqathaniswa nokulawula okungagciniwe.

Ukuphefumula okuyisisekelo okuvela ekompostini yodwa noma ekompostini yehusk yorayisi, noma e-biochar yekhobho yekhobhoni noma e-biochar ehlanganisiwe nekompostu kwakuphezulu kunokulawula okungagciniwe, okwakufana nokwaphuma ekuqondeni kwe-biochar kuphela.
I-TOC ekwelashini yomquba wedwa nasekuphatheni okuhlanganisiwe komquba we-corn cob ne-biochar, yayiphezulu nge-37% ne-117%, ngokulandelana, kunokulawula.
Ukusetshenziswa ndawonye kwe-biochar yehusk yorayisi ne-compost kwandisa i-MBC nge-132%, kuyilapho ukwengezwa kwe-compost kuphela kwandisa i-MBC nge-247%, uma kuqhathaniswa nokulawula.

Ngamafuphi, ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwedwa noma ukusetshenziswa ndawonye komquba kanye ne-biochar, noma i-biochar ehlanganisiwe, kuye kwathuthukisa izici zekhwalithi yomhlabathi ezifana ne-pH yomhlabathi ne-MBC, futhi kwakhuthaza ukuzinza kwe-C yomhlabathi ngokuthuthukiswa kwe-TOC nokunciphisa ukulahleka kwe-C yomhlabathi ngokuphefumula okuyisisekelo.
U-Biochar kanye nokhumulo kuwathuthukisa umhlabathi wokulima izilimo.

Ucwaningo lolu luphenye indlela i-biochar, into ezinzile kakhulu, ecebile ngekhabhoni, eyenziwe ngezinto eziwile ezingasetshenziswanga, ingasetshenziswa ngayo ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomhlabathi e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara.
Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi i-biochar iyayithuthukisa ikhwalithi yomhlabathi ngendlela efanayo nezinye izindlela eziyizindleko eziphezulu futhi ezingatholakali kalula.
Esinye sezinkinga ezinkulu eziqansa ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara yindlela umhlabathi ulahlekelwa ngayo ukukhula.
Ukuthuthuka kokulingana komhlabathi kuzoholela ekukhuleni komkhiqizo wezitshalo, okuzoqeda ubumpofu basemakhaya futhi kuphendule ukubola kwemithombo yemvelo.
Ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi i-biochar, into ezinzile kakhulu, ecebile ngekhabhoni, ingasetshenziswa ukuthuthukisa ukutheleleka komhlabathi.
I-Biochar iyimikhiqizo evela ekushiseni izinto eziphilayo, noma i-biomass, ngaphansi komoya omncane noma ongenayo.
Kuye kwabonakala ukuthi i-biochar iyandisa indawo ebushelelezi yomhlabathi, iyandisa ukufinyeleleka kwamanzi nomoya, futhi isebenze izilwanyana ezincani zomhlabathi.

Lolu cwaningo luhlolwe umphumela we-biochar ne-compost ekulinganisweni lomhlabathi usebenzisa izibonakaliso ezinjengokuphefumula komhlabathi, i-pH yomhlabathi, ukuba khona kwamagciwane, inani lekhaboni, kanye nenani lenayithrojeni elikhona.
Abacwaningi benze i-biochar yamasosha ommbila, i-coconut nehusk yorayisi besebenzisa i-pyrolysis, okuhilela ukushisa izinto eziphilayo ngaphandle komoya, ku-450 °C esiqandisini esenziwe endaweni.
Abacwaningi benze i-biochar yokuhlwanyela i-coconut usebenzisa i-pyrolysis ku-300 °C naku-700 °C.
Abacwaningi base behlanganisa amasampula omhlabathi ahlanganiswe ne-biochar izinsuku ezingu-30.

Isampuli ngayinye yayinawo umhlabathi okhethekile olungiselelwe okuthiwa yi-Haplic acrisol, owakuhlanganiswa nezinhlanganisela ezahlukene ze-biochar ezenziwe nge-corn cob, i-rice husk noma i-coconut husk, kanye ne-compost yomquba wezinkukhu.
Ezinye izibonelo zazinezimpahla ezihlanganisiwe zomhlabathi kanye nomanyolo wezinkukhu, kanye ne-biochar yehusk yorayisi, ne-biochar ye-corn cob, ngokulandelana.
Isampuli ngayinye yayina-1% ye-compost, i-1% ngayinye ye-biochar, ukuze abacwaningi bakwazi ukuhlola umphumela wokuhlanganiswa kwazo ngayinye ekulinganisweni lomhlabathi.

Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi ukwengeza i-biochar ne-compost ephusheni, ngokwahlukana noma ndawonye, kwandisa izinga le-pH lomhlabathi kusuka ku-0.28–2.29 ama-yunithi e-pH, uma kuqathaniswa nomhlabathi ongaxubiwanga.
Ukukhula kwe-pH kusho ukuthi umhlabathi ube mncane ukuba buhlungu.

Ucwaningo olutholile ukuthi ukuphefumula okuyisisekelo, noma inani elincane le-carbon dioxide elikhishwa yithaka, likhuphuke lapho i-compost kuphela efakwe, noma lapho i-compost ixutshwe ne-rice husk, noma i-corn cob biochar noma i-biochars ehlangene.
Izingcezu zomhlabathi zikhombise ukwanda okuyi-37% kokubola komthombo wemvelo lapho kusetshenziswa umquba wedwala kuphela, kanye nokwanda okuyi-117% lapho i-biochar yommbila ixutshwe nomquba wedwala.

Inani lomsebenzi wama-microorganism likhuphuke ngamaphesenti angu-132 lapho umhlabathi wawunezinto ezihlanganisiwe ze-compost ne-rice husk biochar, uma kuqhathaniswa nokukhula kwamaphesenti angu-247 emasampuleni omhlabathi ayene-compost kuphela.
Imiphumela yocwaningo lolu ikhombisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukunciphisa ukubamba komhlabathi usebenzisa i-biochar, elula futhi iyathengwa kalula.
Lokhu kuphambene nokuqeqeshwa okunye kokufaka ilayimu emhlabathini, okubiza futhi akunakutholakala kalula kubalimi abancinyane e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara.
Inethiwekhi ye-Fibrin Fibre Engaqondakaliyo ye-Arthritis ye-Rheumatoid kanye nobuhlobo bayo nokuziphatha komzimba, ukuvuvukala kanye ne-Thrombosis.
Ingozi yezehlakalo ze-cardiovascular kubantu abane-RA ikhuphuka ngokungalingani ngenxa yokuvuvukala komzimba wonke.
Imiphumela ehambisanayo yokuguqulwa kwe-autoimmune-associated citrullination esakhiweni nasemandleni okubangela i-thrombotic ye-fibrin(ogen) isalokhu ingaziwa.

Ngakho-ke saqhathanisa izikhombisi zomsebenzi wezinsimbi zegazi, ukuvuvukala, ukuhlanganiswa kwegazi kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwe-fibrin clot kubantu abane-RA nabantu abaphilile, saqhathanisa nobuhlobo phakathi kwemiphumela.
Izihlanzi zegazi zibuye zithathwe kubantu abagulayo be-RA abangu-30 kanye nabantu abaphilile abangu-25 abalinganiselwe ngeminyaka nobulili.
Amazinga e-SAA, i-CRP, i-ICAM-1 ne-VCAM-1 alinganisiwe kusetshenziswa i-sandwich immunoassay.
Ukuhlanganiswa kwegazi lonke kuhlolwe kusetshenziswa i-Thromboelastography.
Ukuxhumana kwe-fibrin clot kanye nesakhiwo sefayibha kuphenyiwe kusetshenziswa i-Scanning Electron Microscopy.
Ukubona nokulinganisa ukuguqulwa kwe-citrulline ezigangeni ze-fibrin ezakhiwe kwenziwe ngokusebenzisa i-antibody ye-Citrulline ephakathi ne-fluorescently ephakathi ne-Confocal Microscopy.
Amazinga e-SAA, i-CRP ne-ICAM-1 aphakanyisiwe kakhulu kubantu abane-RA uma kuqathaniswa nokulawula.

Izilinganiso ze-TEG ezihlobene nokuqala kokugandeka kwegazi (R ne-K), izinga lokuxhumana kwe-fibrin (i-α-Angle), nesikhathi sokufeza ukukhiqizwa okukhulu kwe-thrombus (TMRTG) kunciphisiwe kubantu abane-RA.
Izilinganiso eziphathelene namandla e-clot (MA, MRTG, TGG) azange zihluke ngokomibalo phakathi kwe-RA namaqembu okuqhathanisa.
Ukuboniswa kwemodeli yokubuyisela i-logistic kwabonisa ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinto ezisabela ezingxenyeni ezibuhlungu (CRP, SAA) nezinombolo ze-TEG kunamamaki okusebenza kwe-endothelial.

Ukuhlaziywa nge-microscope kwembule izinhlanganisela ezinzima zefayibha ze-fibrin ezinzima kubantu abane-RA uma kuqathaniswa nokulawula [i-median (i-interquartile range) 214 (170-285) vs 120 (100-144) nm ngokulandelana, p<0.0001, i-Odds ratio=22.7).
Ukutholwa kwezindawo eziningi ezicitrrullinated ngaphakathi kwemizimba ye-fibrin clot kubantu abane-RA, okwakuncane kakhulu emasampuleni okulawula (p<0.05, OR=2.2).
Abaguli abane-RA esebenzayo babonisa iphrofayili yokugqwala igazi engalingani nemiphumela jikelele ehlotshaniswa nezinye izimo zokuvuvukala.

Ukuguqulwa kokwakheka kwamapurotheni yi-citrullination ehlobene nokuziphatha komzimba kungadlala indima ekuqondeni ubukhulu be-fibrin kanye nethuba lokuletha ingozi enkulu ye-thrombotic kubantu abane-RA.
Ukugandeka kwegazi kubantu abane-arthritis kungachaza ingozi yabo ephakeme yokuhlaselwa yisifo senhliziyo, isifo sobuchopho.
Ucwaningo olusha olumayelana nohlobo lwe-rheumatoid arthritis luhlinzeke ngokuqonda okungcono ngokuxhumana okungenzeka phakathi kwalesi simo kanye nengozi ephakeme yesifo senhliziyo.
Ukuvuvukala kwamajozi (RA) kuyisimo esibuhlungu nesiphazamisayo sokuziphatha komzimba, esihambisana nokuvuvukala kwamajozi nakubumzimba bonke.
Sekuyisikhathi eside manje, ososayensi bayazi ukuthi labo abagulayo banengozi engu-50% ephakeme yokuthola izifo zesistimu yomchamo (CVD) – njengokuqhaqhazela noma ukuhlushwa yinhliziyo.
Iphuzu eliyisihluthulelo kulowo mngcipheko iwukuthi ukuvuvukala kuthinta kanjani inqubo yokugqwala kwegazi.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bahlolisise lobu budlelwano, ukuze bathole ukuthi kungani ngempela i-RA ikhuphula ingozi ye-CVD.
Ngokuqondile, abacwaningi bahlole imiphumela yokuvuvukala nokuguqulwa kwesakhiwo kumaprotheni athile ahlobene nokuqina kwegazi, okuthiwa yi-fibrins.

Lezi zidakamizwa zikhona njengezintambo ezinde ezakha “umsebenzi” oyisisekelo weziqephu zegazi, ngakho noma yikuphi ukuguqulwa kwe-fibrins ngokwazo kungaba nemiphumela emibi ekuqinisweni kwegazi ngokujwayelekile.
Abacwaningi baqathanise amasampula egazi abantu abane-RA namasampula abantu abaphilile.
Kulawo wonke amacala, abacwaningi babefuna “izimpawu” egazini ezibonisa ukuvuvukala, kanye nanoma yimaphi umehluko ongaqondakali ekuqinisweni okuvamile kwegazi okungandisa ingozi ye-CVD.
Ama-clots ngokwawo nawo ahlolwe ngemicroscope, ukuze kubonwe noma yikuphi ukuguquka kwesakhiwo se-fibrin protein yawo.

Abacwaningi baphawula ukuthi izicubu ezivela kubantu abane-RA zakha ngokushesha kunalezo ezivela kubantu abaphilile, nokuthi izinhlanganisela zeprotheni ezazenziwe nazo zazikhulu kakhulu kunama-fibrins avamile.
Kwakukhona futhi ukuguqulwa kwama-amino acid akha amaprotheni e-fibrin, okwabangela ukuba aqalise impendulo yomzimba yokuvikela, okubangele ukuvuvukala okwengeziwe.

Abaphandi abanye baye baphawula izinguquko esakhiweni se-amino acid yama-fibrin ezinhlangothini zabantu abane-RA ngaphambili, kodwa lokhu kuyisikhathi sokuqala abaphandi bebona umphumela ofanayo egazini.

Uma kuhlanganiswa nezinye izinguquko ezibonwe ezigcawini zegazi, okutholakele kungasiza ososayensi ukuthi bathuthukise ukuqonda okujulile kokuthi ubuhlobo phakathi kwe-RA ne-CVD bunjani, nokuthi ungazibona kanjani izimpawu zalezi zifo ekuqaleni.
Nakuba lezi ziphumo zokuqala zithembisa, kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi inani lesampula yocwaningo lalingancane ngokulinganiswa.

Abacwaningi baphinda bakhuluma ukuthi indlela abayisebenzisile yokuthola ukuguqulwa kwama-amino acid eprotheni nayo ingase ithole imiphumela evela ezintweni ezingahambi kahle, okusho ukuthi kuzodingeka ukuhlolwa okuqondile okuqondene nama-fibrins ukuqinisekisa umphumela esikhathini esizayo.
Ekugcineni, ukuqonda ubudlelwano obuyingozi phakathi kwe-RA nokungena engozini enkulu ye-CVD kungathuthukisa imiphumela yabagula be-RA njengoba sifunda ukubona nokuphatha lezi zifo ngokuphumelelayo.
Abacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika, eDenmark nase-United Kingdom babehilelekile kuleli cwaningo, elalixhaswe yi-South African Medical Research Council.
Izibikezelo zezimo zezulu zasemanzini zabasebenzisi bolwandle lwasemgwaqeni – imibono, ukusetshenziswa nokusetshenziswa kwazo.
Ucwaningo olukhona luhlosile ukubhekana nokungafani phakathi kwesayensi nabantu ngendlela yokungafani okungenzeka phakathi kokunikezwa nokuthandwa kolwazi okwaziwa ngokuthi yi-usability gap.
Kulesi simo, sihlola ukubaluleka kolwazi lwemozulu yolwandle (metocean) njengoba kubonakala kubasebenzisi emazweni amabili eNingizimu Hemispha:
iNingizimu Afrika neNyuzilani.

Lapha, ukugxila akuyona kuphela emibonweni, ukusetshenziswa nokusetshenziswa kokubikezelwa kwemicimbi ehlasimulisayo, kodwa kunokugxila ekubeni nokubandakanyeka kokubikezelwa okuvamile, okujwayelekile.
Ucwaningo lwenziwe ngokusebenzisa uphendulo, oluhlelwe ngemibuzo yokucwaninga emithathu.

Imibuzo yocwaningo ihlanganisa izindikimba ezihlukahlukene kusukela ekusebenzeni kalula kwemishini yokubikezela, ukunemba nokuhambisana, ukusetshenziswa kalula, idumela lezikhungo, nokungabaza okuhlobene noshintsho lwesimo sezulu (okumbalwa nje).
Imibuzo eku-inthanethi yasatshalaliswa kabanzi ukuze ihlanganise abasebenzisi bokuzijabulisa nabokurhweba.
Ucwaningo luye lwasebenza ekubeniqonde amasiko okwenza izinqumo angase abe nomthelela oluhlukile ezidingweni zolwazi lwabasebenzisi bolwandle lwasemgwaqeni.
Uhlalutyo lokuvumelana komdabu (CCA) lusetshenziswe ukuphenya ukuqondana okuhlanganyelwe nokuhlukahlukana kokubona phakathi kweqembu elikhulu labaphenduli kanye neqembu elihlukile ngezigaba nezwe.
Sithole amazinga ahlukahlukene okuvumelana eqenjini lonke (abahlanganyeli basemazweni womabili kanye nawo wonke amasekhta aqoqwe) uma kuqhathaniswa namaqembu ahlukene abasebenzisi.

Bonke abahlanganyeli behlangene babonisa ukuvumelana okuvamile komphakathi ngokuqondene nezindaba ezazibekwe, kodwa ngezinye izinguquko zemibono ezingeni lezizwe, okubonisa ukuthi kungenzeka kube khona amasiko aphansi.

Uma sihlaziya amaqembu ahlukene ezizwe nakwezindawo ngokwahlukana, sathola ukuvumelana okuhambisanayo kakhulu komoya wamasiko eqenjini labasebenzisi baseNingizimu Afrika, ngokuvumelana okukhulu kungakhathaliseki ukuhlanganyela kwezindawo.
Iqembu labasebenzisi bezentengiselwano lase-New Zealand lalihambisana kakhulu nabanye abantu abancane.
Sixoxoxa ngemiphumela evela kwimithombo yethu mayelana nezici ezibalulekile ekusetshenzisweni kwezinsizakalo, futhi ngakho-ke ekukhiqizweni kokubikezela okubalulekile.
Kukhona nezinto eziningi ezibalulekile zeziprognostications ezisekelwe esayensi esikhathini esizayo ezicatshangelwa, kucabangwa imiphumela elikhulelwe yoshintsho lwemozulu.
Siphetha ngokuncoma umdwebo weconsceptual ukuze sigqamise ukusebenzisana okubalulekile phakathi kokubambisana ekukhiqizeni iziprofetho nokulunga/ukuhambisana kwesayensi.
AbaseNingizimu Afrika, abaseNew Zealand bathemba izibikezelo zesimo sezulu olwandle.
AbaseNingizimu Afrika nabaseNew Zealand abasebenza futhi bahlala emagqumeni basuselwa ezinsizakalweni zokubikezela isimo sezulu ezilula ukuzisebenzisa, futhi ezihlale zinikeza ukubikezela okuqondile.
Amasevisi kazwelonke okubikezela isimo sezulu namawebhusayithi amaningi ezohwebo anikeza izibikezelo zokuthi isimo sezulu sizoba njani.
Bazimisela ukuba nembala nangokusebenziseka ngangokunokwenzeka.
Isayensi enkulu kanye nokucabanga okwesayensi kungenela kulobu buqikithi.

Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bakhetha ukubheka indlela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika naseNew Zealand abasebenzisa ngayo izinsizakalo zokubikezela – womabili amazwe anamahlathi amade, kodwa anabemi abahlukene kakhulu nezimimo zasemahlathini.

Babefisa ukwazi ukuthi ngazikhathi zingakanani laba bantu basemgwaqeni belwandle basebenzisa izinsizakalo zokubikezela zezwe noma zezohwebo, ngamabomu ani, nokuthi ngabe bazithole ziwusizo futhi zinethemba.
Lezi yizici ezibalulekile uma kubhekwa ukuthi ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu esikhathini esizayo kungathinta kanjani ukuqagela kwesimo sezulu.
Imibuzo eku-inthanethi iphendulwe abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abangu-31 nabantu baseNew Zealand abangu-126.

Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa abantu abasebenzisa izibikezelo zesimo sezulu ngenxa yemisebenzi yabo (umzekelo abalobi kanye nezinhlangano zokusesha nokusindisa), nabanye ababamba iqhaza emisebenzini yezemidlalo neyenjabulo ehlobene nolwandle njengokugibela amaza, ukuhamba nge-paddle, noma ukubhukuda.
Abacwaningi babuze ngokuthi kulula kangakanani ukusebenzisa isevisi yokubikezela isimo sezulu esikhethiwe, nokuthi ukubikezela kwayo kwakunembile futhi kuqondile kangakanani.
Ababambiqhaza baluhlu lutho oluwenzile ukuba lube luncedo futhi lubaluleke kubo, futhi bathi uma lokhu kungashintsha ngenxa yoshintsho lwesimo sezulu.
Kwakudingeka futhi bathi noma bayethemba yini ulwazi olunikezwe izinsizakalo zezulu zasezweni labo, nokuthi bazizwa kanjani ngalo.
Iningi lama-South Afrika athathe ingxenye kulokhu kuphenyo kwakuwaba-surfers, noma abantu abasiza emisebenzini yokusesha nokophula noma eziprojekthini zocwaningo.
Abantu abaningi baseNew Zealand abaphendule imibuzo babebuka izibikezelo zesimo sezulu ngoba babefuna ukuya ukudoba, ukuqhuba isikebhe noma ukuhamba ngomkhumbi olwandle.
Ababambiqhaza belizwe zombili babemethemba ulwazi abaluphiwe yi-National Weather Services yabo.
Babethanda izinsizakalo zokubikezela ezinembile, ezihlala zifanayo, ezilula ukuzisebenzisa futhi ezinemikhakha engaguqulwa ukuze zifanele izidingo zabo.
Ababambiqhaza abasebenzise le nsizakalo ngenhloso yemisebenzi ngokujwayelekile bathole ukuthi izibikezelo zezimo zasemanzini olwandle eduze komkhumbi zazingezona ezinembile ngokwanele.
Ulwazi lweminye imikhakha lwalunembile kunolunye.
AbaseNingizimu Afrika babethanda ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zezulu kakhulu kunabaseNew Zealand, futhi babebukele okungenani kanye ngosuku.
Kubaphenduli abayi-9 kwabayi-10, uhlelo oluhle kakhulu lokubikezela lwalubaluleke kakhulu.
Abaningi bakhetha isevisi enikeza ukubuka kusukela ezinsukwini ezintathu kuya kwezingu-7 kusasa.
Abantu abasebenza ekulimbeni kwezilwane zasolwandle noma ababefanele bahlele ngezimo ezingenzeka eziphuthumayo bafuna ukuqagela kwesikhathi eside nokwezinkathi.

Abasebenzisi abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi ngenxa yokwanda kokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, izinsizakalo zokubikezela kuzofanele zisebenzise ulwazi olusekelwe esayensi oluhle nakakhulu esikhathini esizayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunemba kokubikezela.
Ucwaningo olunje olungakanani alukawuthathwa emazweni aseNingizimu Hemisphare.
Abacwaningi bathemba ukuthi bakwazile ukufunda okwanele kubantu ababambene ngokuya ngemibuzo abababuze yona.
Omunye ubuthakathaka obunokwenzeka yikuthi abantu abaningi abahlala eNew Zealand kunaseNingizimu Afrika babeqoqezelele kulokhu kuphenyo.
Umsebenzi wabo uzosiza abantu abasebenza ezinsizakalweni zokubikezela isimo sezulu ukuklama imikhiqizo engcono ethatha izidingo zamaklayenti abo.
Bayokwazi ukwenza uthuthuko kanye nezinguquko ngokuya ngokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende abo nokuthi kungani bawasebenzisa.
Indlela Yokubamba Iqhaza Ekulinganiseni Ubuhle Bezinhlelo Zokusebenza Ezolimo Ezifanelekela Isimo Sezulu:
Icala laseLushoto
Umqondo wezolimo oluhlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu (CSA) uyaqina emhlabeni jikelele.
Kodwa-ke, aliqondile ngalokho okufanele kufakwe phansi kwezinsika zalo ezintathu—ukukhiqiza, ukuqina nokunciphisa.
Ngenxa yalokho, i-CSA ihlanganisa izindlela/izinkambiso zezolimo eziningi ezahlukene, okwenza kube nzima ukukhetha imigomo ye-CSA.
Okokuqala, kunokuntuleka kokulinganisela okuqondile nokusebenza kanye nezindlela zokuhlola ubuhle bezingxenye ezikhuthaza ukumelana nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu.
Okwesibili, ulwazi oluncane lukhona mayelana nethonya lezinqubo ezihlukahlukene eziveliwe njenge-CSA, ikakhulukazi ezweni elithuthukayo.
Ekugcineni, ukwenza phambili kwe-CSA akubheki imibono yabanakekeli ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izixazululo zisebenza, zifanele futhi zinekhono elikhulu lokwamukelwa.
Lapha, sichaza uhlelo olusha lokuhlanganyela lokulinganisa ubuhlakani bezezimboni zezolimo ekuqondeni ukumelana nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu emisebenzini yabathengisi abancinyane.
Lokhu kuqopha izibonakaliso (nezikhombo) zezinga lefama zezinsika zezokuphepha kokudla nokuziqondanisa kwe-CSA.
Kuyasekela futhi ukubala okuhlanganyelwe kwezinkomba, okuvumela ukwenziwa kokulinganisa okuqala nokwekusasa kokuhlakanipha kwezimo sezulu.
Le phrotokoli yalingwa phakathi kwabalimi abangu-72 abasebenzisa izinhlobo ezihlukahlukene zezinhlelo zokusebenza ze-CSA eLushoto, eTanzania, eyi-village ehlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu.

Abalimi ngokukhethekile babeqakathekisa izinhlelo ezaziphucula ukukhula komhlabathi nesakhiwo sawo, ezinciphise ukugeleza kwamanzi ezingqimba, futhi ezibuyisela izwe eliwohlokile ngenxa yemiphumela emihle ekukhuleni kwemikhiqizo kanye nezolimo zemikhiqizo yasezinyangeni ezishisayo.
Ikakhulu, izinhlelo zokusebenta ze-CSA zandise ukukhiqizwa kwezilwane, ukukhiqizwa kokudla, ukusetshenziswa nokungenisa imali.
Leli phrotokoli kulula ukulilungisa ngokwezindawo ezahlukene nezinhlelo zokulima futhi liyavumela ukuqondiswa kangcono kokungenelela.
Kodwa sincoma ukuthi i-CSA yamukelwe njengengxenye yenqubo yokubeka iliso, ukuhlola nokufunda.
Izindlela ezintsha zokubeka iliso zisiza ososayensi kanye nabalimi ukuba balungiselele ushintsho lwemozulu.
Oososayensi abasebenza nabalimi eThanzaniya manje bangalinganisa ukuthi izindlela ezintsha zokulima zisebenza kangcono kangakanani ekuqedeni imiphumela yoshintsho lwesimo sezulu.
Bathemba ukuthi indlela yabo izokuthuthukisa ukuphepha kokudla kanye nemikhiqizo yemifino yabalimi nakwezinye izingxenye zezwe.
“Ukukulima okuhlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu” kuyinto i-United Nations eyikhuthaza ukusiza abalimi abancinyane ukuba balungiselele ushintsho lwesimo sezulu.
Umgcini wezitshalo oqondayo isimo sezulu uzilungisa ngokushintsha kwezimo zezulu futhi uyakwazi ukwandisa ukuphepha kokudla ngokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo zakhe.
Lena yinkinga ebaluleke kakhulu kubalimi baseTanzania, njengoba izwe selihlushwa ukwehla kokuvuna kwezitshalo ezibalulekile zezinhlamvu ngenxa yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu.

Kodwa-ke, abacwaningi bathi kunzima ukulinganisa impumelelo yezinhlelo zokusebenza eziqaphela isimo sezulu, njengokwenza umanyolo, futhi abalimi ngokwabo ababuzwa njalo ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza zisebenza yini ngendlela ebhaliwe.

Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuklama indlela yokulinganisa impumelelo yezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu, ngokugxila ngokukhethekile ekulungiseni ukuphepha kokudla nokuguquguquka.
Ukuqala, bafunda ezinye izifundo zezolimo, baphumelela ohlwini olu-2 oluhlanganisa izici eziyi-14, noma “izibonakaliso”, ezibalulekile ekuqondeni ukuphepha kokudla nokuguqulwa.
Bese, bebenza eLushoto District eTanzania, abacwaningi basebenzisana nabalimi bendawo kanye nochwepheshe abaningi bezemilimi ukuze baqonde izibonakaliso ezibaluleke kakhulu kuwo wonke uhlu.
Abalimi baqaphele ukukhiqizwa kokudla njengophawu oluqakathekile kakhulu lokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kokudla.
Ngamanye amazwi, noma iyiphi imisebenzi eyenze ukukhula kwezitshalo zabo kwaba ngcono yayibaluleke kakhulu.
Okwamanje, ngokuqondene nokuqondana, abalimi babekhuthele kakhulu ezinqubweni ezazibasiza ukuthi bavikele umhlabathi wezimafa zabo, kanye nalezo ezithuthukisile ulwazi, amakhono, kanye nomholo wabo.
Ngemva kokuba abacwaningi sebeqinisekisile ukubaluleka kwesibonisi ngasinye, bakwazi ukuzisebenzisa ukuhlola ukuphumelela kwezinhlobo eziyisithupha zezinhlelo zokusebenzelana eLushoto.
Kuzo zonke izimo, babuze abalimi bendawo, ngesikali esingu-1-5, ukuthi ngabe bekukhona ukwanda kwesibonakaliso ngasinye kusukela lapho kuqalwa khona ukungenelela.
Lokhu kwabavumela ukubona ukuthi yiziphi izixazululo ezazinomphumela omkhulu ekukhuleni kokudla nokuguqulwa.
Bathole ukuthi kuphela ukungenelela okungu-3 kwezingu-6 ebezisetshenziswa kwakunethonya langempela.
Lezo zazikuyi-crop varieties ezibola, ezingakhuli kahle ngesikhathi sompompo, futhi zinikeza ukudla okungcono kwezilwane.

Abacwaningi bathi indlela yabo yenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokungenelela zesikhathi esizayo zihlangabezana nezidingo zabalimi baseLushoto kanye nemigomo yokuhlinza kwezolimo oluhlakaniphile.

Bengeza ukuthi ukukhetha izindlela zokungenelela ezifanele kuphinde kukhulise amathuba okuba abalimi bancoma amasiko amahle kubamelene babo, ngaleyo ndlela basakaza imibono ehlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu.

Ngokuyisisekelo, le ndlela ingasetshenziswa nakwezinye izindawo, futhi ingasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi amasu ahlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu abheka izimo zendawo nolwazi lolwimi ngokubeka iliso okuqhubekayo nokulinganisa.
Ngokuyenza kanjalo, izinhlelo zokulima eziqaphela isimo sezulu zinezindlela eziningi zokuphumelela futhi zithole ukwamukelwa, kokubili eTanzania nakwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika.
Ucwaningo lwaluyisivumelwano phakathi kwesayensi evela eKenya naseNetherlands.
Izifo zezilwane ezinamagxolo njengezinhlobo ezihlaselayo: Ukuqonda okuvela eNingizimu Afrika
Ucwaningo lwezinto eziphilayo ezibangela izifo njengezinhlobo zasemzini ezihlaselayo aluzange lutholakale ukunakekelwa okukhulu ensimini yesayensi yokuhlasela.
Izifo ezifakwe zingaba nemiphumela emikhulu ezidalweni eziphilayo, ezinhlelweni zezinto eziphilayo ezihlala kuzo, nasezimweni zezomnotho ezisekelwa yilezo zinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo.

Kulesi sahluko, sisebenzisa izifundo zezimo zezifo ezithunyelwe ezilwaneni zasekhaya nezasendle (ukuthukuthela kwezinja, isifo sofuba sezilwane, ne-rinderpest) nabantu (isihlangu, isifo sofuba, ne-human immunodeficiency virus, i-HIV) ukuchaza izinhlobo zemiphumela lezi zifo ezingayibangela.

Uthonyo olukhulu kunazo zonke oluye lwabonakala kuze kube manje luye lwaba lukarinderpest, oluholele ekufeni kwezinkomo eziningi, futhi lwabhubhisa cishe izinhlobo ezithile zezilwane zasendle ezingxenyeni ezinkulu zaseNingizimu Afrika.
Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni wesifunda, futhi kwabangela ukuguquka okukhulu kwesakhiwo kanye nedinamiki yezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo.

Isifo se-Rinderpest sisusiwe emhlabeni wonke, kodwa bobabili isifo se-rabies sezinja kanye ne-tuberculosis yezilwane ezifuywayo basaphila, futhi kuzodingeka ukulinda nokuqapha okuqhubekayo ukuze kuvinjelwe.
Ezifweni zabantu, isifo se-smallpox naso siqothulwe emhlabeni wonke, kodwa umphumela wesifo, esafakwa abakoloni baseYurophu, wawubhubhisayo.

Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yo-1700, ingxenye enkulu (fingqa ku-90% kwamanye amabandla) yabantu bakwaKhoekhoe abangabantu bomdabu yafa, yabhubhisa amasiko abo kanye nendlela yabo yokuphila, yashiya abasindile abambalwa ukuthi baqashwe njengabasebenzi befama.
I-HIV, eyatholakala okokuqala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982, iye yaba nemiphumela emikhulu futhi ukwelashwa nge-antiretroviral kudla uhulumeni u-ZAR 66.4 billion ngonyaka.
Siphinde sifake i-West Nile Virus ne-African Swine Fever njengezibonelo zezifo eziqale e-Afrika, futhi ezingase zibe yingozi emhlabeni jikelele.
Sibikezela ukuthi izifo ezintsha ziyophumela njengoba abantu beqhubeka bandise indawo yabo ezindaweni zasendle, futhi njengoba amazinga okuhweba ekhuphuka.
Okwaziwa ngabacwaningi ngabahluphi abancinyane ababangela izifo eNingizimu Afrika

Isahluko sale ncwadi sihlanganisa ulwazi lwakamuva ngezifo ezinjengesi-rinderpest, isifo sokuhlanya, isifo se-measles ne-HIV, zonke ezihambisana nemikrofoni ehlala khona (ama-virus, ama-bacteria nezinye izidalwa ezincane ezibhekwa njengesihlobo esingaphandle, okusho ukuthi azitholakali ngokwemvelo endaweni ethile).
Lezi zifo zonke zithinta izilwane nabantu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ukuqhuma kwazo ekugcineni kulimaza umnotho wezwe.

Enkundleni yocwaningo ebizwa ngokuthi ‘isayensi yokuhlasela’, ososayensi bafunda izidalwa ezikhula futhi zibangele ukulimala ngemuva kokungeniswa ezindaweni ezintsha lapho zingatholakali khona ngokujwayelekile.
Ucwaningo oluningi luye lwogxila ezinhlotsheni ezinkulu “zokuhlasela” njengezitshalo nezilwane, kodwa abahlaseli abancinyane ababangela izifo balingana ngokubaluleka.
Kulesi sahluko, ababhali baxoxe ngezinye izifo zezilwane nezabantu eNingizimu Afrika ezingabangelwa yilezo zinto eziphilayo ezifakwe.
Bathe bathi oluyingozi kunazo zonke kwakuwukugula kwe ‘rinderpest’, okwatholakala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1896.
Isifo se-Rinderpest sasiyisifo esibangelwa yi-virus futhi sasiqeda izinkomo neenqama.
Umsundu ofanayo owabangela i-measles kubantu.
Abantu abaningi basemakhaya bahlushwa yindlala ngemva kokubhebhetheka kuka-1896, kodwa manje isifo sisusiwe ngokugonywa.
Ababhali bathi phakathi kuka-1772 no-1861, izinja eziningi eNingizimu Afrika zazinobhubhane, yize abantu babengalwazi ukuthi iyiphi leyo gciwane.
Ngo-1893, kwakwaziwa ukuthi i-rabies yayibangelwa yi-virus, ngakho-ke uhulumeni wanquma ukubulala izinja ezihlazweke futhi abayekezele abangazange bahlazweke.
Nokho, lokhu akuzange kuqede lesifo, futhi lasala lilimaza izilwane eziningi zasendle njenge-duikers, izimpisi, izinja zasendle, ama-jackal nama-foxes.
Ababhali bathi ngo-1928, abantwana ababili bakhonjwa yi-Yellow Mongoose bafa ngenxa yebhubhane.
Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi, irabhi yaba yinto evamile eNingizimu Afrika.
Bathe bathi ngo-1954, abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika nabo bathinteka yi-measles.
Lapho le sahluko sibhalwa, isifo sikamasela sasibulawa abantwana abangaba ngu-400 nsuku zonke.
Bathe bakhuluma ukuthi isifo sikamabulelo besivame lapho abantu nemfuyo bekudedelana khona.
Ababhali bakhulume futhi ngesifo esibizwa ngokuthi i-bovine tuberculosis (BTB), esibangelwa yibhaktheriya.
IBTB yabulala izinkomo, izinyathi, izinqindi, izinyezi, iingwe, ama-kudu, amabhabhu kanye nezingonyama.
Bathe bakhuluma ukuthi isifo se-BTB sabikwa okokuqala ephaki likazwelonke laseNingizimu Afrika ngo-1996.
Uhulumeni walawula leyo gciwane ngokubulala izinkabi ezigulayo.
Ababhali bathi omunye umkhuhlane, owayeziswe eNingizimu Afrika ngabahambi baseYurophu, wabangela isifo esibizwa ngokuthi ‘isihlangu’ kubantu.
Lesi sifo sibulale abantu abangaphezu kuka-90% beKhoekhoe bendawo.
Ekupheleni kokuphahlazeka kwesifo, isiko lamaKhoekhoe lalibhujiswe cishe ngokuphelele.
Ababhali babike futhi nge-human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) eyabangela ukuphahlazeka kwesifo se-AIDS.
Oososayensi basacabanga ukuthi i-virus iqale yadluliselwa kubantu evela ezilwaneni, ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi yi-zoonosis.
Ukuqhuma kwaleli virusi kwatholakala okokuqala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982.
Bathe bathi, kusukela ngo-2019, i-HIV yayingenayo imithi yokwelapha noma isifo.
Baqede isahluko ngokukhuluma nge-West Nile Virus ne-African Swine Fever, abathi zaqala e-Afrika zasaqhubekela eYurophu naseMelika.
I-West Nile virus idluliselwe yizinyosi futhi yabulala ikakhulukazi izinyoni, kodwa futhi yathinta amahhashi nabantu.
Bathe bathi izilwane ezifana nezingulube zasehlathini nezinkomo zasehlathini zithwalela isifo se-African swine fever.
Ulukhuni lwathinta ingulube, futhi lwathinta kakhulu ibhizinisi lezingulube.
Ababhali bathi bakhulume ngezifo ezingcoliswa yibhaktheriya nezinambuzane kuphela, ngakho-ke le sahluko asiyona ingxelo ephelele yazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezincane ezingena emzimbeni.
Ababhali babevela eNingizimu Afrika.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lokuhlinzwa olusekwe ebufakazini lokuqondisa i-Odontogenic keratocyst
Ukuphathwa okuphumelelayo kwe-odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) kuhlala kuyisihloko esithakazelisayo nesidida ezingxoxweni zobuhlengikazi bomlomo nemaxillofacial.
Okwamanje, ayikho imvumelwano mayelana nokwelashwa okuhle kakhulu kwabagula abane-odontogenic keratocyst.
Kwezinketho ezahlukene zokwelapha ezitholakalayo, akukho luhlobo oluye lwabonisa amazinga okubuyela kabusha angama-zero noma aseduze ne-zero ngaphandle kokusika okubanzi ngemikhawulo ecacile.

Ngenxa yokushoda kwemibhalo ebonisa izindlela zokwelapha eziqondene nokwelashwa kwabagula abane-odontogenic keratocyst, ucwaningo olukhona luhlosile ukwethula uhlelo lokusebenza lokuhlinzwa, olusekelwe emiphumeleni ye-meta-analysis, elithemba ukuthi luzoba usizo ekwenzeni kube ngcono ukwelashwa kwabagula abanesimo.

Sisebenzisa izilinganiso ze; usayizi, uhlobo lokulimala (oluyinhloko noma olusekondari), ubuntu be-syndromic noma olulodwa lokulimala, ukuba khona kokubhoboza kwe-cortical, kanye nokuhlukaniswa; sinikeza umuthi wokunquma, ukusiza ukuhlela ukwelashwa futhi usize ukufeza amathuba amancane okuphinda kuvela ekuphathweni kwe-odontogenic keratocyst.
Abacwaningi baphinde baphakamise izindlela zokwelapha kangcono isifo semaxa.

Ngokuhlanganisa imiphumela yocwaningo olukhona, abacwaningi baqamba izinyathelo ezicacile abagqirha abangazilandela ukuze bahlonze futhi baphathe iziguli ezine-sickness yomhlathi ebizwa ngokuthi ‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
I-OKC iwumkhuhlane, noma ukukhula okungavamile, emaxatheni omuntu.
Odokotela bathola ukuthi lesi simo kunzima ukusiphazamisa, futhi iziguli zivame ukuthola enye i-OKC ngisho nangemva kokwelashwa okuphumelelayo.
Ngakho-ke, odokotela bafuna izindlela zokwelapha ngempumelelo nangokuphelele lezi zilonda ze-jaw.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna izinyathelo ezibalulekile abaguli kufanele bazithathe ukuze bahlonze futhi baphathe lesi sifo.
Bakenze lokhu ngokucinga ezincwadini ezikhona, noma ezihloko zesayensi, mayelana ne-OKC.
Babecinga ngokuqondile ulwazi mayelana nendlela odokotela abaphatha ngayo i-OKC phakathi nonyaka, njengoba kubikwe ezihlokweni ezingu-46 abazitholile.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi i-OKC yayivame kakhulu kumadoda kunabesifazane, futhi ingathinta abantu abaneminyaka efinyelela ku-90, ngisho noma yayivame phakathi kweminyaka engu-20 no-30.
Ubuhlungu buye babathinta kakhulu amaxhafu angaphansi.
I-OKC iqala ngaphakathi kwempumputhe, nokukhula komlomo kubonakala kamuva kuphela.
Abantu abagulayo bavame ukuzwa ubuhlungu futhi babe nokuqothuka okuthile (isigaxa, njengophuphu, oluphuma ehlengeni noma ebuhlungwini), futhi imizuzu yamazinyo abo ingase iphume endaweni.
Baphinde basekele ukuthi odokotela basuse yonke inxeba namazinyo aseduze.

Uma sekuqediwe ukususa, kufanele basebenzise imithi ebizwa ngokuthi yi-Carnoy’s solution, kanye ne-liquid nitrogen (ilwesi elipholile kakhulu elisetshenziswa ekuqedeni ngokushesha isikhumba esonakele) ne-fluorouracil (eyaziwa nangokuthi yi-5FU, imithi evamile yomdlavuza).
Ngemva kwalolu phiko, abacwaningi bancoma ukuthi umuntu ophethwe kufanele abe nokuhlolwa kwezempilo okulandelayo iminyaka engaphansi kuka-25.
Bathe bathi leli phiko lolukuqondene kakhulu nezilonda ezincane kunesithelo se-strawberry (3 cm).
Kubalulekile ukunaka kakhulu izilonda ezingaphezu kuka-3 cm.
Bathe bathi odokotela kufanele baqale banciphise ukucindezela ngaphakathi kwesilonda bese basusa ulwelo, futhi basuse zonke izicubu ezizungezile umgubhu.
Kumelwe kube sekuphathwa ngesixazululo seCarnoy.
Baphinde basekele ukuthi odokotela kufanele bahlole laba ziguli njalo ngenyanga ezimbili iminyaka emibili.
Uma isiguli sinamalengalenga amaningi, odokotela bangase bawakhuphe ngezinsimbi ezikhethekile zasezibhedlela.
Kodwa ngokujwayelekile, izifundo ezabuyekezwa zikhombise ukuthi ezimweni eziningi, uma odokotela besusa isifo bese befake i-5FU, iziguli azizukubuye zithole i-OKC.
Kodwa-ke, baxwayisa ukuthi ubufakazi balezi zindlela zokwelapha babungelona oluqinile njalo, futhi bathola izincwadi zesayensi ezimbalwa ngale ndaba.
Abacwaningi abazange benze namaciko abo ukuze banikeze lezi zincomo; kunalokho, bazama ukuqoqa izinketho zokwelapha ezihamba phambili ezaziwa ezivela ocwaningweni oluyenziwe abacwaningi abanye.
Ngakho-ke, labo bacwaningi, abahlala eNigeria nase-USA, bancoma ukuthi kwenziwe izifundo eziningi emazweni ahlukene ukuze kuvivinywe impumelelo yemithi ephakanyiswe lapha.
Baphethe futhi odokotela ukuba bacabangele ezinye izimo zabaguli ngesikhathi sokwelapha.
Isifo se-SARS-CoV-2 (2019-nCoV), i-MERS-CoV ne-SARSr-CoV esenziwe ngokwenziwa: Ukuhlaziywa komshini okuqhathaniswayo ukusikisela ama-epitope avumelekile.

Ama-coronavirus avame ukuba ngawomkhakha othize wezilwane njengomxhasi, izilwane ezincelisayo noma izinyoni kuye ngohlobo lwazo; kodwa-ke, le mi-virus ingashintsha umxhasi ngezinye izikhathi ngenxa yokuguqulwa.
I-HCoV-229E ingenye yama-coronaviruses ayisithupha abantu, ehlanganisa i-HCoV-NL63, i-HCoV-OC43, i-HCoV-HKU1, i-MERS-CoV ne-SARSr-CoV (i-SARSr-CoV-1 ne-SARS-CoV2) futhi isabalale emhlabeni jikelele.
I-MERS-CoV ne-SARS-CoV-2 zingaphila ezintweni ezingaphili njenge (ensimbi, igalasi noma ipulasitiki kuze kube izinsuku ezingu-9) (Huang, C.-L, 2020).

Izinyathelo zokuvikela kanye nokuphathwa kwemithi nge-hydroxychloroquine kuyasiza, kodwa kungenzeka ukuthi kudingeka umuthi oluhlaza oluphumelelayo ukuze kuvinjelwe ukwanda kwesifo sikamahlalakhona i-covid-19.
Inhloso yocwaningo lwethu kwakuwukubona ama-epitope okugomela ngezindlela ze-bioinformatics.
Izinto Nezindlela

Uchungechunge oluphelele lwe-genome luka-SARS-CoV-2 luthathwe ku-2019 Novel Coronavirus Resource (2019nCoVR) nasezinkundleni zedatha ezimbili, okuhlanganisa i-National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) Global Initiative on Sharing All Influenza Data (GISAID) ne-TAURAU/T-bio-infoserver yokusebenza kwe-bioinformatics online.

Sizokunikeza isifinyeto esifushane sokuvela kwe-viral, siqhathanise idatha yokulandelana ukuhlonza indawo ezivikelwe, i-domain yayo yeprotheni evame kakhulu (indawo yokubopha umgomo) kanye nokuklama i-motif evumelanayo yomkhiqizo we-molecule onamandla (epitope) oqaphelwe ngenhloso yemizamo yokwelapha ye-2019-nCoV, i-SARSr-CoV strain ne-MERS-CoV ezintsha.
Kuyathakazelisa ukuthi, ukufaniswa kwe-sequence phakathi kwe-SARS-CoV-2 nezinye izinhlobo kuveze ukuthi izinto ezikhona ku-receptor-interacting motive zigcinwe kakhulu ngokufana okungu-70%.
Sisekele ama-amino acid abalulekile amahlanu (L455, Y473, N479, F486, Q493) esizindeni sokubopha i-receptor evela kumaphrotheni e-spike abhekene nokuthintana phakathi kwe-virus ne-horst.
Ku-SARS-CoV-2 RBD kukhona izinsalela (D480, ne-T487) ezavumela ukutheleleka phakathi kwezinhlobo.
Kodwa-ke, ku-SARS-CoV-2, ukuguqulwa okuncane kweminye imfucuza kungathuthukisa ukusebenzisana nomukhahleli we-cellular wabantu: L455, F486, Q493, ne-N501.
Ku-SARS-CoV, izinsalela ezimbili eziyinhloko (479 no-487) ziye zahlanganiswa nokuqashelwa komukeli we-ACE2 wabantu.
Ku-SARS-CoV-2, izinsalela ezifanele ku-N479 zihambelana ne-Q493 ne-T487 kuya ku-N501.

Sikhombe uchungechunge lwamanye ama-amino acid agcinwe kahle kuwo wonke ama-coronavirus, kuhlanganise ne-2019nCoV nezinye izinhlobo, i-motif i-KRSFIEDLLFNKVTLADAGF itholakale ikhulu igcinwe kahle kuleli cwaningo futhi ihambisana nendawo ezungezile kwenye yezindawo ezaziwayo zokusika ze-SARS virus okukholelwa ukuthi kuyadingeka ukuvuselela i-virus ukuze ingene eselini.

Le motif yeqhaza kanye nezinguquko ezizungezile zakha isisekelo sokusikisela i-epitope yeqhaza le-vaccine elenziwe ngokukhethekile; lo mtholampilo ungenza abavikeli abancinyane abanamandla futhi ababopheka.
Lolu cwaningo lunikeza ulwazi nethuba lokukuqinisekisa ngokwesayensi.
Lokhu kusebenza kungachazwa ngamagama e-bioinformatics, futhi kuphindwe kalula abanye, yize idatha entsha nocwaningo lwe-Covid-19 luvela futhi luqhubeka ngesivinini esikhulu.
Oososayensi baqhathanisa i-Covid-19 nezinye izifo ezifana nayo ukuze basize ekufuneni ama-vaccine.
