NgoSepthemba 2020, ososayensi baseMali baqhathanisa ulwazi oluvela e-genetic virus yeCovid-19 nama-coronaviruses amabili ahlobene eduze ukuze baqonde izici ezingasiza ekuthuthukiseni i-vaccine.
Ngaleso sikhathi, ososayensi babeyasafuna izigqoko zokuqeda i-Covid-19 eziphumelelayo.
Babefisa ukubona ukuguqulwa kwe-Covid-19 virus okungase kudlale indima ekuthelelekeni.
Ngakho-ke, abacwaningi baseMali baqhathanise i-Covid-19 virus (SARS-CoV-2) nezinye izinhlobo ezimbili ze-coronavirus ezibangela izifo kubantu, okuyi-MERS-CoV ne-SARS-CoV.
Enye yezinjongo eziyinhloko zocwaningo kwakuwukuthola izindawo ezithile e-Covid-19 virus, ebizwa ngokuthi yi-epitopes, ezingabonwa yi-immune system yabantu.
Ukubabonisa kungabasiza ososayensi ukuba benze izigqoko eziphumelelayo kakhulu.
Abacwaningi baphinda bafanisa ama-virus amathathu ukuze babone ukuthi kukhona yini ukufana kwe-genetic okungasiza ekuthuthukiseni imithi yokugcoba.
Bagxile kwinhlanganisela ye-genetic yephrotheni ye-spike yezifo, eziyizinto eziphethwe ukuncedisa ama-coronavirus ukubopha, nokutheleleka, amaseli abantu.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi amaprotheni e-spike ezingozi zonke ezintathu ayefana kakhulu ngokwemfundo, ikakhulukazi izingxenye ezihlangana namasondo abantu.
Okwakhamba phambili nge-Covid-19 iwukuthi kwakukhona ukuguqulwa okuncane kwe-spike protein okwakwenza i-virus ikwazi ukubopha kahle ezintweni zabantu.
Imiphumela yalesi sifundo ingavumela abanye abacwaningi ukuthi bathuthukise izigqoko ze-Covid-19 eziphumelelayo ngokubasiza ukuthi baqonde izindawo ezinobhubhane ezingamathuluzi amahle ezigqoko.
Ucwaningo luphinde lunikeze ulwazi olusha mayelana nokuthandana nokungafani kwezakhiwo ze-genetic phakathi kwe-Covid-19 nezinye izinhlobo ze-coronavirus.

Abacwaningi baphawule ukuthi ucwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo kufanele lugxile ekutheni ukwahluka kwe-genetic ku-Covid-19 virus kuyenza yaba nomthelela omkhulu futhi iyingozi kunezinye izifo ze-coronavirus.
Ukuphazamiseka Kokushaya Kwenhliziyo Kubantu AbabeNe-COVID-19: Ukuhlaziywa Okuseqophelweni Nokuhlaziywa KweMeta-analysis
Ukuphazanyiswa kwenhliziyo akumele kuphazanyiswe kubantu abane-coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) njengoba kunomthelela omkhulu emiphumeleni.
Ngakho-ke, le ncwadi ihlose ukwakha ubufakazi obuqinile mayelana nokwanda kwe-cardiac arrhythmia kubantu abane-COVID-19.
Senze ukucinga okuhleliwe kwama-database/izinjini zokucinga ezithembekile okuhlanganisa i-PubMed, i-Scopus, i-Cochrane library ne-web of science.
Ngemva kokuhlola, idatha efanele ikhishiwe futhi izingozi ezivela eziphengulweni ezihlanganisiwe zihlanganiswe ukuze kwenziwe i-meta-analysis.
Ekugcineni, ucwaningo oluyisishiyagalolunye lufake ekuhlolweni kwethu oluqukethe iziguli ezingama-1445.
Imiphumela yokuhlaziya okuhlanganisiwe ikhombisile ukuthi ukwanda kwe-arrhythmia kubantu abane-COVID-19 kwakungu-19.7% nge-95% confidence interval (CI) ephakathi kuka-11.7 no-27.6%.
Kwakukhona futhi ukungafani okukhulu (I2□=□94.67%).
Ukuhlupheka kwenhliziyo kwakukhulu kakhulu kubantu abane-COVID-19 futhi kubonwe ku-19.7% kubo.
Ukubhekwa okuqondile nge-electrocardiogram, kanye nokuhlonza okuchane kanye nokusheshayo kwe-arrhythmias kubalulekile ekuphatheni nasemiphumeleni emihle.
Abantu abaningi abane-Covid-19 babe nezingcindezi ezingajwayelekile zenhliziyo.
Abacwaningi bathi cishe omunye kubantu abangu-5 abane-Covid-19 uhlangabezana ne-cardiac arrhythmia, eyaziwa nangokuthi ukushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile.

Ngenxa yokuthi kuyinto evamile kangaka, bayekethisa ukulandelela izindlela zokuphefumula kwenhliziyo yomguli usebenzisa umshini obizwa ngokuthi yi-electrocardiogram, ukuze odokotela bakwazi ukubona futhi baphathe noma yimaphi ama-arrhythmias ngokushesha okukhulu.
Nakuba i-Covid-19 ilimaza amaphaphu nesistimu yokuphefumula kakhulu, ucwaningo oluthile lubonise ukuthi ingalimaza nenhliziyo.
Abacwaningi bafuna ukuhlola idatha yabagula ukuze babone ukuthi izinkinga zokushona kwenhliziyo zazivame kangakanani ngempela kubantu abane-Covid-19 ngo-2020, ekuqaleni kwenhlekelele yomhlaba wonke.

Benze ukuhlaziya okuhlanganisiwe, okuyilapho abacwaningi behlaziya izifundo eziningi ezahlukene ngesihloko esithile ukuze bazame ukuthola iziphetho eziyinhloko ezivela kuzo zonke izifundo ezihlanganisiwe.

Bafuna izifundo ezibuyekezwe ngontanga eyenziwe abacwaningi abanye kuma-database avamile, futhi bakhipha noma yiluphi ulwazi olufanele mayelana nokushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile kubantu abane-Covid-19.
Ekugcineni, bafake izifundo eziyi-9 ezinolwazi mayelana nabantu abagulayo abayi-1445.
Bathole ukuthi ukungazinzi kwenhliziyo kubonwe ku-19.7% yabagula be-Covid-19.
Kepha bayaxwayisa ukuthi inani elincane lezincwadi abazisebenzisile lingase liqede isiphetho sabo.
Ezinye zezifundo azizange zichaze uhlobo oluqondile lwenkinga yentliziyo, futhi ukulinganiselwa kwesifundo ngasinye kungadida ukulinganiselwa kokuhlaziywa kwazo okuhlanganisiwe.
Baphinde baphakamise ukubheka kusasa ukuthi kungani iziguli eziningi ezine-Covid-19 zazinamazinga ezingqondo ezingavamile.
Ababhali bale ncwadi bevela eGibhithe, kodwa iziguli kulokhu kuphenyo bevela eChina nase-USA.
Imiqondo Yezinye Izazi Zesayensi Ngokuthuthela Kwezwe, Impilo Yengqondo Ne-PTSD:
Ukuhlola kwezincwadi ezifanele
Kulesi sahluko, sinikezela ngokubuyekezwa kwezifundo zokulinga eziqhutshwe ku-PTSD, impilo yengqondo nokuzwela kwabafuduki.
Ucwaningo oluningi lubonisa ukuthi kokubili abacindezelayo bangaphambi nobangemuva kokufuduka baphazamisa impilo yengqondo kanye ne-PTSD yabafuduki nababaleki.
Emazweni okuqala, ukubhekana nokulimala nokuhlushwa kwakuyingozi enkulu empilweni yengqondo yabafuduki.

Izinkinga zempilo yengqondo ezibangela ukucindezeleka okukhulu kubafuduki emazweni ababamukele zifaka phakathi ukucindezeleka kokuzifaka endaweni entsha, isimo somthetho, ukuhlukaniswa komndeni, isikhombandlela solimi, ukufinyelela okubi kunakekelwa kwempilo efanele, ukucwaswa, ubuhlanga, imizwa yokungabi namandla, ukwehla kokuzithemba, ukucindezeleka okuqhubekayo nokuqapha okukhulu.
Phakathi kwazo zonke izinkinga zempilo yengqondo, ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka ne-PTSD kubhekwa njengezivamile kakhulu ngeminani yokuvela engu-4–40%, 5–44% no-9–36% ngokulandelana.
Ngokuvamile, ukwesekwa komphakathi nezindlela zokubhekana nezinkinga ezihlukahlukene kubonwe njengokuvikela.
Impilo yengqondo yabaphambukeli ithonya yisimo esishiywe ngemuva nokuxazulula endaweni entsha.
Abantu abathuthela kwamanye amazwe nababaleka bavame ukuhlupheka ngokucindezeleka okungapheli emva kokulimelela nezinye izinkinga zempilo yengqondo.
Nakuba izinkinga eziningi zibangelwa izinto ezenzeka emazweni abo, ososayensi bathi kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukucindezeleka kokuphila ezweni elisha kungakwandisa inkinga.
Ngokwocwaningo oluningi, ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, kanye ne-post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) konke kuyizinkinga zempilo yengqondo ezivamile phakathi kwabafuduki nababaleki.
I-PTSD ngokuvamile iyimbangela yokusinda kwezehlakalo eziyingozi noma ezilimazayo, futhi abantu bavame ukuhlangabezana nemiphumela yalezo zenzakalo ezimbi izinyanga, noma ngisho neminyaka.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuqonda izici ezahlukene ezidlalayo indima ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo yabantu abathuthela kwamanye amazwe njenge-PTSD.
Ngakho-ke, benze uhlobo locwaningo oluthiwa yi-review, lapho bebuqula khona ulwazi oluvela kwezinye izifundo eziningi ngale ndaba, ukuze bathole izindlela ezivamile noma izingqikithi.
Ezimweni eziningi, izinkinga zempilo yengqondo zabafuduki zazibangelwa yizenzakalo ezibuhlungu ezinjengempi, ukulahlekelwa abathandekayo, noma ukuhlaselwa ngokomzimba okwenzeka emazweni abo.
Lapho laba bantu bephuma kulezo zimo, bahlangabezana nezihambi ezinzima kodwa-ke bazizwa bekhululekile lapho befika ezweni elisha.
Abacwaningi, noma kunjalo, bathi lokuphumula kwakuyisikhashana, ngoba abantu abathuthela kwamanye amazwe babhekene nezinselele ezintsha ngemva kokuthuthela.
Bathole ukuthi izifiki zivame ukuba nezikhathi ezinzima ezweni elisha, ikakhulu uma zingalwazi ulimi, noma zinezinkinga zokujwayela isiko.

Uma abantu befike ezweni ngokungekho emthethweni, noma babezama ukuthola ukukhosela, kwakudingeka babhekane nezingqinamba zomthetho, futhi bavame ukuba nobunzima bokuthola izinsizakalo ezinjengalezo zezempilo.
Kwabanye, ubandlululo nobuhlanga ezweni labo elisha kwenezela emizwelweni yabo yokungaphephile, futhi abaningi bashiye amalungu omndeni ngemuva futhi babe bodwa.
Lezi zinto zifake isandla ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo eziqhubekayo, ngisho nalapho lezi zifiki zisesezimweni eziphephile kunalezo zasezizweni zazo.

Abacwaningi benezela ukuthi izifiki zazinezindlela eziningi ezahlukene zokubhekana nalezi zinkinga, kusukela ekucwaningeni ngokucophelela ukuthi zingazixazulula kanjani, kuya ekufuneni usizo kwabanye emphakathini wazo, noma izindlela ezimbi njengokusebenzisa izidakamizwa.
Abacwaningi bathi ucwaningo olwengeziwe luyadingeka ezinyathelweni zonke zohambo lwabantu abathuthela kwamanye amazwe.
Ngokuqondile, kubalulekile ukucwaninga izinto ezihilelekile empilweni yengqondo emazweni abantu abahlala kuwo, kodwa futhi isikhathi eside emazweni abo amasha.
Bengeza ukuthi uhambo lwabantu oluvela e-Afrika luyisuka eYurophu ludinga ukunakekelwa okuningiliziwe yibo abacwaninga.
Ucwaningo lolu lwaluyisivumelwano phakathi kwesayensi ehlala eNingizimu Afrika naseJalimani, futhi luyinxenye yencwadi ephathelene namava abafuduki base-Afrika abahlala emazweni aseYurophu.
Ukuba khona nokuhlala isikhathi eside kwe-Amblyomma hebraeum kuwukhuluza umthwalo we-Heartwater esifundeni esingaseningizimu yeBotswana.
I-Heartwater yisifo esithwalwa yizikhonkwane, esibangelwa yi-haemoparasite, esinokukhawula ukukhula kwamabhizinisi ezimakhi eBotswana.
Lesiyingozi ekuvikelweni kokudla kwesizwe kubangelwa ukukhiqizwa okuncane nokufa kwemfuyo ekulimeni okungelona ibhizinisi lezimfuyo ezincane kunasemapulazini ezinkulu.
Ucwaningo lolu lunikeza umbono wemfanelo ye-epidemiological yesifo se-heartwater eBotswana.
Izikhuhlu ezikhulayo ezilwaneni ezikhona ezigabeni ezine zaseNingizimu eBotswana zaziqondwe ngokusebenzisa ukuhlaziywa komzimba kanye nokusebenzisa i-molecular.
Abalimi bebuzwa ngokuphathwa komthwalo we-heartwater ezigabeni zabo.
Imibiko yezimo zeklinikhi zezilwane yabuthwa ukuhlola ukwanda kwezimo kulo lonke isifunda saseNingizimu eBotswana.

Imiphumela yocwaningo iveze; ukwanda okukhulu kwe-Amblyomma hebraeum kuzo zonke izindawo ezine ezifundwe, ukwanda kancane kweminyaka yecala le-heartwater esifundeni saseMoshupa nokubonisa ukwanda komthelela ezinhlotsheni zezimbuzi zasekhaya naphezu kokuzimisela kokulawula izimbangi ngo-63% lwabafuyi abaqashwe.

I-Amblyomma hebraeum, umthwali oyinhloko we-Ehrlichia ruminantium eNingizimu Afrika, isabalalele kakhulu eSigabeni Eseningizimu saseBotswana futhi ngaleyondlela ibeka inselele ekukhiqizeni ezilwane ezifuywayo kulesi sigaba, mhlawumbe, nakwezinye izindawo zezwe lapho i-tick lihlasela khona izilwane ezifuywayo.
Ngakho-ke, kunesidingo sokubuyekeza kabusha izindlela zokulawula izikhuthuli ezikhona ngenhloso yokunciphisa umthwalo wosulelelo lwe-heartwater, ikakhulukazi ezinganeni nasezimbuzini.
Inani elikhulu lezinyamazane eNingizimu Botswana liyenza isifo se-heartwater ezilwaneni ezikhulelwayo sibe sibi nakakhulu.
Lolu cwaningo lubika ngomthwalo obanzi wezinambuzane ne-heartwater kule ndawo eNingizimu Botswana phakathi kuka-2017 no-2019.
Imiphumela yocwaningo ingasiza uhulumeni nabalimi ukuba benze amacebo okulawula kangcono isifo se-heartwater.
Ama-tick athile athatha ibhaktheriya ebizwa nge-Ehrlichia ruminantium, ebangela isifo esaziwa ngokuthi yi-heartwater ezinkomeni, eemvini nasezimbuzini.
Leli bakteri liyisihluku, okusho ukuthi liyadla ezinye izidalwa eziphilayo njengezilwane, lilibangele ukulimala.
Izilwane ezikhulayo ezina-heartwater, ngokuvamile zihlale zineminikelo yomzimba ephezulu, zilahlekelwe yisifiso sokudla, zinezinkinga zokuphefumula, futhi zingase zife ekugcineni.
I-Heartwater ivame kakhulu ingxenyeni eningizimu yeBotswana, futhi abalimi kule ndawo bayalahlekelwa yizilwane zabo ngenxa yesifo.
Kulesifundo, abacwaningi bahlole umthwalo we-heartwater eNingizimu Botswana.
Baqala ngokuqoqa, ukubala nokubona izikhuthuli ezinceleni, ezinganeni zezimvu nezimbuzi ukuze baqhathanise inani lezikhuthuli eziphethe i-parasite ye-heartwater nezinye izikhuthuli.
Abacwaningi baphinda bexoxisana nabanye abalimi ngamava abo nge-heartwater, futhi baqoqe eminye imibiko ye-heartwater ehhovisi lezilwane (lempilo yezilwane).
Abacwaningi bathi izikhuthazi eziyingozi zazibanzi endaweni yocwaningo, nokuthi inani lezimangalo zesifo se-heartwater likhuphuke unyaka nonyaka.
Baqoqe ama-tick angu-310 phakathi kuka-2017 no-2019.
Bathole izinhlobo ezintathu zezinambuzane: inambuzane yaseNingizimu Afrika, inambuzane enezinyawo ezimhlophe, kanye nenambuzane yebhubesi ebomvu.
Eyona ivamile kwakuyi-tick yaseNingizimu Afrika (85%), futhi yile eyihambisayo ibhaktheriya ebangela isifo senhliziyo.

Ezinye izinhlobo ezimbili zezinambuzane abazitholile azinayo indima ekusabalaleni kwesifo se-heartwater, kodwa zihlanganiswe nezinye izifo zezinkomo ezifana ne-'theileriosis', 'anaplasmosis' ne-'babesiosis'.
Indawo eyacwaningwa yizifundiswa ihlanganisa iGoodhope, iKanye, iMoshupa, neJwaneng.
Izikhuhlu zaziningi eGoodhope, eKanye naseMoshupa.
Lezi zindawo zaziningi zinothile, zinamatshe futhi zinezitshalo eziningi.
IJwaneng, elalinenani elincane kakhulu lezinambuzane, lalomile, liyisilika futhi lalinoluhlaza oluncane.

Abacwaningi bathi amarekhodi ezilwane aziveze ukuthi kwaba nezimbangela ze-heartwater ezingama-42 eGoodhope, ezingama-38 eJwaneng, ezingama-75 eKanye, nezingama-146 eMoshupa, kusukela ngo-2017 kuya ku-2019.
Abacwaningi bathi isifo se-heartwater sithinta izimbuzi nezinkomo zasekhaya kakhulu kunazo ezivela kwamanye amazwe.
Bathe bathi abalimi benze imizamo ethile yokulawula izikhuhlu.
Isibonelo, u-63% wabalimi bahlanza izilwane ngezidakamizwa (amakhemikhali asetshenziswa ukubulala izinambuzane ezinjengezinyamazane).
Cishe ingxenye yesithathu (30%) yabalimi yasebenzisa amafutha ezilwaneni zabo ukulawula izikhuhlane, kanti abanye (7%) basebenzisa ukwakha izingadi ezintsha.

Abacwaningi bakuthola futhi ukuthi u-44% wabalimi abazange benze lutho ukuze baphathe isilwane esinecala, kuyilapho u-15% bathi babeyovakashela abaphathi bezokwelapha izilwane ukuze bathole iseluleko, kodwa banikeza izilwane imithi ngokwabo.
Ngaphandle kokuba kwakukhona isifo sokuvikela isifo se-heartwater, abacwaningi bathi u-93% wabalimi abazange basisebenzise.
Abalimi batshela abacwaningi ukuthi kwakungenxa yokuthi babengafundiswanga nge-vaccine, futhi ngoba babengenakukwazi ukuyikhokhela i-vaccine.

Ezinye izifundo esikhathini esidlule zihlole indlela izikhuthuli ezisasakazwa ngayo e-Afrika, kuhlanganise ne-Botswana, kodwa ngokusho kwabacwaningi, eyabo kwaba yiyona yokuqala ukubheka ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhuthuli nezimpawu ze-heartwater e-Botswana.

Bathe bathi amacala e-heartwater abhalwe odokotela bezilwane angase abe mancane kunamacala eqiniso abhekene nawo abalimi, ngoba odokotela bezilwane bavame ukuhlola kuphela isifo se-heartwater lapho isilwane sifile, okusho ukuthi izilwane eziphila ngalesi sifo noma izilwane eziphulukile azibalwa njalo.
Abacwaningi baye bancoma ukuthi abalimi kufanele bafundiswe indlela yokulawula nokuphatha isifo se-heartwater ezinkomeni zabo, ukuze kuncishiswe umthwalo waso kule ndawo.
Baphinda bathi kufanele kwenziwe ucwaningo olwengeziwe ukuze kuqondwe izinto eziholela ekukhuleni kwama-tick.
Abacwaningi babehlala eBotswana.
Izithiyo Zokuhlola Okwenziwa Endaweni Yokunakekelwa E-India NaseNingizimu Afrika

Ukuhlolwa kwesikhathi (POC) emiphakathini, emakhaya, nasezikhungweni zezempilo zokuqala kukholelwa ukuthi kunamandla amakhulu ekunciphiseni ukulibaziseka ekuxilongeni nasekuqaleni kokwelashwa kwezifo ezinjengobhubhane lwe-HIV, isifo sohlwempu, isifo sesifilisisi, ne-malaria.

Ukuxilongwa okusheshayo nezinqumo zokuphatha okuqhubekayo okwenziwa ngesikhathi esifanayo sokuhlangana kwelapho noma okungenani ngosuku olufanayo, ngesikhathi isiguli silinde, kuthembisa ukunqoba ukulibaziseka okuhlotshaniswa nokuhlolwa okuvamile okusekelwe elabhorathorini.
Kodwa-ke, ukuba khona kokuhlolwa okuthengayo, okulula, nokusheshayo okungenziwa ngaphandle kwelabhorethri akukwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuphumelela kokuhlolwa kwe-POC ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Ukuze siqonde izindima ezintsha nezinselele ezihlangabezana nazo izinto zokwelapha ezinjengalezi, kudingeka sihlole ukuthi ukuxilongwa kusetshenziswa kanjani e-POC futhi kuhlanganiswe kanjani emsebenzini nasezindleleni zabaguli.
Isahluko esilandelayo sihlola imiphumela ekhethiwe evela ephrosektini yocwaningo olufanele mayelana nezingqinamba zokuhlola i-POC eNdiya naseNingizimu Afrika futhi luxoxa ngazo ngokulinganayo.

Le projekthi isebenzise izingxoxo ezingaqukatha isimo esithile nezingxoxo zamaqembu ukuhlola amasiko okuxilonga ezifweni ezinkulu nabalingisi ekhaya, emaklinikhi, emphakathini, ezibhedlela, nasezilabhorethri eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
Uma siqhathanisa imiphumela ekhethiwe, kucace ukuthi womabili amazwe anamasistimu ahlukene kakhulu okuxilonga anikeza izimo ezihlukene kakhulu zokuhlola i-POC.
Isahluko siphetha ngokubheka indlela yokuthatha lezi zibonakaliso ezingqondweni lapho kuqanjwa izinhlelo zokuhlola i-POC.
Ukuhlolwa okubi kwezempilo endaweni eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya kulimaza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo.

Ukukhathalela endaweni (POC) kubhekisela ekuhlolweni kwezempilo okwenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho isigulane samukela khona ukunakekelwa, kunokuthi kuthunyelwe amasampula esigulane kwenye ilebhu ukuze kuhlolwe.
INingizimu Afrika neNdiya azinikisi ukuhlolwa okusheshayo nokusebenza kahle ngenxa yemisila yazo emibi ye-POC nama-labhorethri.
Ukuhlolwa kwe-POC kuvumela iziguli ukuba zithole ukuhlolwa okusheshayo ngemiphumela esheshayo yokwelashwa nokuphathwa kwezifo.
Lokhu kungenziwa ngemishini ephansi futhi elula engabuyisela imiphumela yokuhlola ngokushesha ngaphandle kokuthatha amasampula e-labhorethri.
Kodwa kuningi inselele e-POC elicimeza ukunakekelwa kwabagula eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
Ababhali babefuna ukuqhathanisa ukuhlolwa kwe-POC eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya ukuze bakwazi ukubona izinkinga.
Baqhuba izingxoxo nemihlangano yamaqembu nabasebenzi bezempilo, iziguli kanye nezinkampani zezinto zokwelapha kusukela ngoSepthemba, 2012, kuya kuJuni, 2013, kuwo womabili amazwe.
Babuze ngezinqubo nezingqinamba ze-POC.
Esemphakathini wezempilo, eNdiya kusetshenziswa izilab ezincane eziningi futhi kwenziwa ukuhlolwa okuyisisekelo, kodwa lezi zilab azinikwa imali eyanele, ngakho-ke azinamakhambi anele okuhlola.
Abalwelwe bavame ukutshelwa ukuba babuyele ngolunye usuku noma baye kwenye indawo, okubangela izinkinga kubalwelwe.
Abacwaningi baphawule futhi ukuthi ngezinye izikhathi abaguli bayahlolwa kodwa kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuze imiphumela ibuye, futhi bathola kunzima ukuxhumana nodokotela wabo ngemva kwalokho.
Ababambiqhaza bathi kufanele kube nezikhungo zokuhlola eziningi emagulini, nokuthi ukuhlolwa kungenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho iziguli zingena khona.
Baphinda bathi ukulandelela, ukwelashwa noma ukwelulekwa kufanele kwenzeke endaweni efanayo.
ENingizimu Afrika, bathole ukuthi ezinsizakalweni zempilo zomphakathi, inkampani eyodwa ilawula yonke ivivi, ngakho amasampula aya kule nkampani.
Ezinye izivivinyo eziyisisekelo zenziwa lapho kunakekelwa khona, futhi iziguli zithola imiphumela ngokushesha.
Uvivinyo lwe-HIV ne-TB luthatha isikhathi eside ngakho-ke ukulandelela noma ukwelashwa kuphinde kulibale.
Ukubambezeleka okunye kubangelwa ukuphathwa, ukubhala amagama abantu abagulayo ngokungalungile, ukumarkisha amasampula ngokungalungile, nokuwohloka kwezinhlelo zekhompyutha.
Ekwenzeni ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV, amanye ama-lab asebenzisa izindlela ezihlukene zokuhlola, futhi lokhu kunikeza imiphumela engenathembeko.

Bathole ukuthi iziguli zizama ukuhlolwa lwe-HIV ngokuya ngobubanzi bendawo noma uhlobo lokuhlolwa, futhi ngenxa yalokho ngezinye izikhathi zisebenzisa ikhadi lokuhlonza elihlukile, okubangela izinkinga uma kuzama ukuthola imihlangano yokulandelela.
Abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo kumele basebenzisane ukuze bahlanganyele umsebenzi.
Bathe bathi uma kuza amakiti amasha okuhlola u-HIV, abasebenzi kufanele baqeqeshwe kabusha futhi izinhlelo kufanele zithuthukiswe.
Ababhali baqathanise idatha ye-POC evela kuwo womabili amazwe futhi baphakamisa ukuthi iziphathimandla kufanele zihlole i-POC ngokufanele ngaphambi kokwengeza imikhiqizo emisha noma amadivayisi.
Baphinda bathi kufanele kube khona umzamo omkhulu wokubhekana nemisebenzi eminingi emakilabhu nasekufundeni indima umguli ayidlala ekunakekelweni kwempilo yakhe.
Ababhali bale ncwadi bevela eNingizimu Afrika, eNdiya, eCanada naseNetherlands.
Ukuya ekuchazeni ukugula okunzima kanye nokunakekelwa okunzima ngokusebenzisa ukuhlaziywa komqondo

Njengoba “ukugula okunzima” no “kunakekelwa okunzima” kungabi nazichazelo ezihambisanayo, ucwaningo lolu luhlomele ukuhlola indlela imiqondo esetshenziswa ngayo, lichaze izimfanelo zayo eziyinhloko, futhi liphakamise izincazelo ezingasebenza.
Sisebenzise indlela kaWalker no-Avant yesinyathelo ngesinyathelo sokuhlaziya umqondo.
Ukusetshenziswa nokucaciswa kwalezi zindlela kutholwe ngokubuyekezwa okubanzi kolwemi (scoping review) kanye nokuhlalutya oku-inthanethi kwabachwepheshe bezokwelapha emhlabeni jikelele abangu-114.
Ngokuhlaziya okuqukethwe kwedatha, sikhiphe amakhodi, izigaba nezihloko ukuze simise izimfanelo eziqondisa imiqondo bese sichaza okungenzeka ukuthi kuyizichazamazwi.
Ukuze kusize ekuqondeni, sibonisa imodeli, izimo ezihlobene neziphingayo eziphathelene nemibono, sibonile izimbangela nemiphumela yemibono, futhi saqondisa izinkomba zokulinganisa.

Izimpawu ezihlukanisayo zesifo esibuhlungu kwakuyingozi enkulu yokufa okusheshayo; ukungasebenzi kahle kwamalungu abalulekile; isidingo sokukhathalelwa ukuze kuvinjelwe ukufa; kanye nokubuyiselwa okungenzeka.

Izici ezihlukanisayo zokunakekelwa okubalulekile kwakuwukubona, ukuqapha nokuphatha ukugula okubalulekile; ukusekelwa kwamalungu omzimba abalulekile; ukunakekelwa kokuqala nokuqhubekayo; noma yikuphi ukunakekelwa kokugula okubalulekile; kanye nemithombo yabantu nezinto ezikhethekile.

Uchazo lwethu oluphakanyisiwe lobuhlungu obukhulu yilokhu: “simo sempilo embi esinekhuba ekuhlanganyeleni komzimba, ingozi enkulu yokufa okusheshayo uma ukunakekelwa kungabi khona, kanye nethuba lokubuyiselwa esimweni esijwayelekile.”

Uchazo lwethu oluphakanyisiwe lokunakekelwa okubalulekile yilokhu: “ukubona, ukuqapha nokuphatha iziguli ezinezinhlungu ezingathi sína ngokusekelwa kokuqala nokuqhubekayo kwemisebenzi yamalungu abalulekile.”
Imibono yokugula okuyingozi kanye nokunakekelwa okuyingozi ayinawo amachaza-mvelaphi avumelanayo futhi isebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene.

Ngokuhlaziywa kwemicabango yokusetshenziswa nokucaciswa kwemibhalo nakubachwepheshe, siye saqonda izici ezichaza imicabango futhi sichaza incazelo engasiza umsebenzi wokwelapha, ucwaningo, nokwenza izinqubomgomo.
Amandla Nokulinganiselwa Kwesifundo
Lolu cwaningo lokuhlaziya imiqondo yilolu lwokuqala ukuchaza ngendlela ehlelekileyo ukusetshenziswa nokucaciswa kwemiqondo yokugula okukhulu nokunakekelwa okukhulu.

Ucwaningo lusebenzisa ukuhlola okubanzi kolwazi nemininingwane evela kubachwepheshe bezokwelapha abangaphezu kwekhulu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene emhlabeni wonke ukuze kuhlonishwe izici eziqondisa futhi kunikezwe incazelo ephakanyisiwe yemibono.

Kungenzeka ukuthi ezinye izindlela zokusetshenziswa nezincazelo zemiqondo ngezilimi ezingaphandle kwesiNgisi, ezincwadini ezingashicilelwe nezingacatshangwa, nakubachwepheshe bezokwelapha abangafakwanga kulokhu kuphenyo, azikwazanga ukubalwa.
Njengoba ukusetshenziswa kwamanje kwalezi zindlela kuhlukahlukene, izincazelo eziphakanyisiwe zingase zingamukeleki yonke indawo futhi zihloselwe ukukhuthaza ingxoxo eyengeziwe.
Abacwaningi bahlolisisa kabusha incazelo yabagula kakhulu kanye nokunakekelwa kwabo.
Imibhalo eqondile yokunakekelwa kwabagula esetshenziswa emhlabeni wonke ngabo bonke odokotela ingasiza ekunakekelweni kwabagula kakhulu.
Kulesi sifundo, iqembu lamazwe ngamazwe lwezifundiswa liphakamisa ukuthi “ukugula okukhulu” kufanele kusho ukuthi ngenkathi isiguli esigula sinenkambo enkulu yokufa, singaphila futhi.

Baphinda bathi “ukunakekelwa” okunikezwa iziguli ezigula kakhulu kufanele kusho noma yiluphi unakekelwa olunikezwa kusukela ezikhathini lapho zifika khona esibhedlela, kwaze kwaba yilapho zifa noma ziphulukile.
Akufanele nje kuphawule ukunakekelwa okusebenzisa imishini ekhethekile.

Esibhedlela, odokotela bavame ukubhekisela kubantu abagulayo kakhulu ngokuthi “abagulayo kabi”, kanti ukunakekelwa nokwesekwa okudingekayo kulaba bantu kubhekwa njengokuthi “ukunakekelwa okubalulekile”.
Kodwa-ke, odokotela abasebenza ezingxenyeni ezahlukene noma ezibhedlela baqonda la magama ngokuhlukile, ngoba incazelo yawo iyahlukahlukana endaweni ngayinye.
Lokhu kuholela, isibonelo, kubantu abagulayo abanemethi yefana bathola ukwelashwa noma ukunakekelwa okuhlukile, kuye ngokuthi ubani obasiza.
Amakhambi ahlukene enza kube nzima ohulumeni ukwazi inani langempela lezigulo ezingathi sína ezweni labo.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi baqale bacwaninga ukuthi odokotela abahlukene bahlukanisa kanjani “ukugula okunzima” no “kunakekelwa okunzima”, bese bephakamisa incazelo ehambisanayo.
Baqoqe ulwazi ngokubuyekeza ezinye izincwadi ezinyathelisiwe.
Baphethisise futhi odokotela abavela emazweni ambalwa ahlukene emhlabeni wonke ababenolwazi lokwelapha iziguli ezigula kakhulu.

Abacwaningi babhale ngezincazelo ezahlukene zezifo ezingathi sína, futhi baphawula ukuthi kwakuxhunyaniswe ngokujwayelekile nethuba elikhulu lokuba iziguli zife; ezinye izingxenye zomzimba zingasebenzi; isidingo sokukhathalelwa ukuze kugwenywe ukufa; kanye nethuba lokuphulukana.
Ngokuphathelene nendaba yokufa nokuphulukana, amanye amachaza athi bonke abagulayo abakhulu bayogcina befile, kanti amanye athi kunesihlahla sokuba umguli angaphulile naphezu kokuba gule kakhulu.

Ekugcineni, abacwaningi baphakamisa ukuchaza isifo esibuhlungu njengesifo lapho amalungu omzimba ayeka khona ukusebenza, lapho kunokwenzeka kakhulu ukuthi umuntu angafa uma engakhathalelwanga kahle, kodwa kunethuba lokuphulukana.

Ekunakekelweni okubalulekile, odokotela babonakala bekuchaza ngendlela efanayo kakhulu, kodwa bahluke ngokuthi ukunakekelwa okunjalo kufanele kunikezwe kuphi, kanye nesidingo sezinto zokusebenza ezikhethekile.
Ezinye imithombo yathi ukunakekelwa okubalulekile kungenzeka kuphela ezindaweni ezithile ezikhethekile esibhedlela ezinamakhamera akhethekile.
Abanye babecabanga ukuthi ukunakekelwa okubalulekile kungafaka ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezikhethekile, kodwa kwakungeyona imfuneko.
Bathe bathi ukunakekelwa okubalulekile kungaphanwa ngisho nasemagumbini avamile esibhedlela, ezindaweni ezincane zezempilo, emphakathini noma ezigulini zezimoto zokulinda.
Bathe bathi ngisho nasezindaweni ezihlwempuzekile, iziguli ezigula kakhulu zidinga ukunakekelwa okubalulekile.

Ngakho-ke, abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi ukunakekelwa okubalulekile kungachazwa njengonke ukunakekelwa okwenziwa kubantu abagulayo abanesifo esibuhlungu kusukela ekuqaleni kokubona ochwepheshe bezempilo ukuze bathole iseluleko kuze kube yilapho befa noma belulama.

Abacwaningi bathi lolu kwakuwuchungechunge lokuqala oluqoqe ulwazi ngezichazelo ezahlukene zokugula okukhulu nokunakekelwa, nokuthi imiphumela yabo izosisiza ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwabantu abagulayo kakhulu.
Kodwa-ke bathi ucwaningo lwabo lungase lubekwe emkhawulweni yiqiniso lokuthi abazange basebenzise amachazamazwi avela kwezinye izilimi ngaphandle kwesiNgisi noma evela emithonjeni engashicilelwanga.
Baphinda futhi bahlangana nodokotela abavela kwamanye amazwe ambalwa kuphela, ngakho-ke ukuhlaziywa kwabo akubameli wonke amazwe emhlabeni.
Abacwaningi, ababevela emanyuvesi aseMalawi, eTanzania, eSweden nase-UK, bathi imibhalo yabo ephakanyisiwe ingashintshwa uma kudingeka.
Ukuhlola okubanzi kwe-genome nge-CRISPR-Cas9 kubonisa i-CENPJ njengomlawuli we-host wokuhlehliswa kokuhlelwa kwe-microtubule ngesikhathi sokutheleleka kwe-Plasmodium eluphethweni.

Ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale ukubonakala kwezimpawu ze-malaria, i-Plasmodium sporozoite eyodwa iyaphekula i-hepatocyte bese ithuthukela kuma-merozoites ayizinkulungwane, ngokwengxenye ngokusebenzisa imithombo yomzimba.
Sikhomba ukuthi ama-microtubules omphakathi ahlela kabusha ngendlela eguqukayo eduze kombhangqwana olukhula lwesigaba se-liver (LS).

Sisebenzisa isikrini se-genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9, sibonile abalawuli be-host bokuhleleka kwe-cytoskeleton, ukuthutha kwe-vesicle, ukucindezeleka kwe-ER/Golgi kanye nokwenziwa kwe-lipid okulawula ukuthuthukiswa kwe-Plasmodium LS.
Lezi zilawuli ezintsha zokutheleleka, kuhlanganise ne-Centromere Protein J (CENPJ), zisibonakalise indlela izikhungo zokuhlela ama-microtubule (MTOCs) zilawulwa ngayo ngesikhathi sokutheleleka.
Amaphuzu e-γ-tubulin abekwe emaphethelweni e-parasite; ukunciphisa i-CENPJ kwakhulise leli-re-localization futhi kwandisa ukutheleleka.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, sibonisa ukuthi i-Golgi isebenza njenge-MTOC engasisona i-centrosomal ngokuhlela i-γ-tubulin nokukhuthaza ukwakheka kwe-microtubule emaphethelweni e-parasite.

Ngokuphelele, sikhomba ukuthi i-Plasmodium LS iqasha i-Golgi yombungu ukwakha izikhonkwane ezithwalwa yi-MT lapho ama-organelles omzimba eqashwa khona ku-PVM, ukuze kusekelwe ukuthuthukiswa kwesigaba se-liver.
Umphumela wethu ubonisa ukuthi abavimbi abaningi be-pharmacological abathintekayo nabanikazi bangavimba ukutheleleka kwe-LS.
Oososayensi bafunda ukuthi i-malaria iyayenza kanjani imisebenzi yeseli ukuze bazame ukwandisa izinketho zokwelapha.
Izilwanyana ezininzi eziphazamisayo zisebenzisa izondlo namandla asemakhaleni ezimangalo zazo zabantu noma zezilwane ukuze ziphinde zivelane.

Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bathole i-jini ezithile eziqoka indima ekuthelelekeni yi-malaria ezicellini zesibindi, okungase kuholele ezinhlosweni ezintsha zezidakamizwa zokulwa ne-malaria esikhathini esizayo.
I-Malaria yisifo esiyintukutuku futhi esingabulala, esibangelwa yi-parasite ye-Plasmodium, esidluliselwa ngokuluma komashi.

Lapho kungena emzimbeni, iPlasmodium iyaluphalaza ngqo isibindi ukuze izale - le nqophamlando yokuqala ilungele ukwelashwa kwe-malaria ngoba ayikho izimpawu zesifo okwamanje futhi lesi sifo asinawo amandla okudluliselwa.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuthola izinguquko ezithile ku-jini namaprotheni eeseli ze-liver ezine-infection ezingashintsha indlela i-infection eyenzeka ngayo.
Besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuguqula i-gene i-CRISPR-Cas9, abacwaningi bakwazile ukucima noma “ukukhipha” ama-gene athile ukuze babone ukuthi yiziphi izinguquko lapho lawo ma-gene engasebenzi.
Bese bayeka amasosha omkhuhlane e-malaria kuwo omabili amaseli e-liver ajwayelekile nawo “asusiwe”.
Lezi zikhamelo ezifana nezipayipi zihilelekile, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ekuhambeni kwezondlo nezinto ngaphakathi kwamaselula, futhi ngokuvamile zenza inethiwekhi eduze nesisindo selula.

Esinye sezinto ezibalulekile ezitholakele yikuthi iPlasmodium ithatha ama-microtubules asemaseleni e-liver – esikhundleni sokuba ama-microtubules aqoqane eduze nenuclues ehambisa izondlo nezinto lapho iseli ikudingayo khona, ama-microtubules aqoqana eduze ne-parasite ehambisa izondlo nezinto ukuze kusize i-parasite ukuzala.

Abacwaningi babone ukuthi lapho beqeda iphrotheni ebizwa nge-CENPJ, i-parasite yaba yimpumelelo kakhulu ekuqoqeni ama-microtubules eduze kwayo, futhi ama-parasite akhula futhi enza amakhophi amaningi awo.
Izazi ze sayensi zithole futhi amanye ama-gene amaningana athinta ukuthi ukutheleleka kwe-plasmodium kuba sibi kangakanani.
Abacwaningi bakhombise ngaphambili ukuthi ezinye izinambuzane zihlanganisa kabusha ama-microtubules ukuze ziguqule izinto eziphilayo ngaphakathi kwebanga ukuze zizisebenzisele zona.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi baqinisekisile ukuthi izinambuzane ze-Plasmodium zingase futhi zisebenzise leli qhinga ukuqondisa ukudla namanye amathuluzi ekukhuleni kwazo.
Kusasa, ososayensi bathemba ukusebenzisa ukuqonda kwabo kokuthi ama-gene nama-parasite ahlangana kanjani ngaphakathi kwamaselula ukuze bathole ukwelashwa okusha kwe-malaria.

Nakuba abacwaningi bathole izinguquko ezithakazelisayo kumaprotheni ase-liver cell ezingxenyeni zokuqala ze-malaria, kudingeka umsebenzi omningi ukuqonda ukuthi i-Plasmodium iyasiguqula kanjani isayensi yeseli kanye nomsebenzi ukuze kutholakale imigomo ethile yemithi.
Amakhulu ezinkulungwane zokufa aqhubeka nokwenzeka unyaka ngamunye ngenxa yemalariya, inani elikhulu lawo lise-Afrika.

Ngokusho kweQembu Lezempilo Lomhlaba, ngaphezu kuka-90% lamacala e-malaria emhlabeni ngo-2019 kwenzeka e-Afrika, okwenza lokhu kube yindaba ebalulekile edinga imizamo eqhubekayo yokulawula nokungenelela.
Ukufika Kwezitshalo Nezidalwa Ezingaphandle Njengengxenye Yomzamo Wokucwaninga Ngokushintsha Komhlaba eNingizimu Afrika
Kulesi sahluko, siqhathanisa ukuthi ucwaningo olungakanani eNingizimu Afrika luqondiswe ekungeneni kwezinto eziphilayo ezingaphandle uma kuqathaniswa namanye amalungu ashintsho lomhlaba.

Sisebenzisa i-Web of Science, sibuyekeze ngendlela ehlelekile izincwadi ezihambelana nezimila ze-ecosystem zaseNingizimu Afrika ezinyatheliswe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 futhi ezihlobene nokungena kwezinto eziphilayo, ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukuqothulwa ngokweqile, ukuguquka kwendawo yokuhlala, ukungcoliswa, kanye/noma i-CO2 yomoya.
Sithole amaphepha afanele angu-1149 ahlolwe ngokwemigomo yabo yokumboza abashayeli kanye nokuhlangana kwabashayeli okunethemba ekuhlukahlukenini kwemvelo noma ezinsizini zekhaya.
Kutholakale umphumela onamandla wendawo nesikhathi emzamweni wokucwaninga.

Okokuqala, umzamo wahlukana phakathi kwezindawo, ngokushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala, ukungcoliswa nokudla ngokweqile okuthola ukugxila okukhulu kocwaningo emazingeni omphakathi, amanzi amnandi nolwandle/izindawo eziseceleni kolwandle ngokulandelana.
Okwesibili, izimpawu ezithile ezifundwe kahle emhlabeni jikelele azibhalwanga ezincwadini zendawo (isib. kwakunemiqulu engaphansi kwehlanu emayelana nokubanda kolwandle).

Sikhonjwe ukusebenzelana okuhlukile okungu-21 phakathi kwabaqhubi, kokusebenzelana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo kanye nokuhluka kwendawo yokuhlala (isibonelo izimo eziguqukile zomlilo ezindaweni ezihlaselekile) okuvelele kakhulu.
Kodwa-ke, okungenani u-4% wemiqondo yayixoxa ngokusebenzisana phakathi kwabaqhubi abathathu noma ngaphezulu.

Lokhu kusikisela ukuthi nakuba kubalulekile ukuqonda ukusebenzisana kwabadali, kuncane kakhulu okwenziwe ngokucwaninga imiphumela ehlanganisiwe yokusebenzisana kwabadali ezinhlelweni ze-ecosystem zaseNingizimu Afrika.

Ukusikisela okuye kwaphawulwa isikhathi eside ukuthi izinhlobo ezihlaselwayo ziyingozi yesibili enkulu kunazo zonke ekulondolozeni ukwahlukahluka kwemvelo, ngemuva kokushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala, kuhambisana nokukhiqizwa kocwaningo oluhambisanayo lolu phawu eNingizimu Afrika.

Ukukhula isithombe esibanzi sokubala ukubaluleka okulinganiselwe kokushayela kokuguquka komhlaba kuzoba inselele, hhayi kuphela ekuchazeni okucacile kokushayela, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokungalingani kokutholakala kwemiphumela yocwaningo ezilinganisweni zesikhathi nezindawo ezifanayo.
Ukuvuthwa okuhambelanayo komsebenzi mayelana nezinhlobo ezihlaselayo kungaba yisisekelo sokuphenya ukusebenzelana okunjalo okunzima futhi ngaleyo ndlela kusize ekuqedeni izithiyo ezinjalo.
Abacwaningi kumele balandelele imiphumela ehlangene yezinhlobo ezihlaselayo, ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu nemisebenzi yabantu eNingizimu Afrika.

Izinhlobo ezihlaselayo yisongo lesibili elikhulu ekulondolozeni ukwahlukahluka kwemvelo eNingizimu Afrika - iqiniso elihambisana, kubika abacwaningi, nenani lezincwadi zocwaningo ezenziwe ngale ndaba.
Lokhu kuhambisana nezinye izingozi ezifana nokungcoliswa, ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukubulala ngokweqile noma ukushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala.

Lezi zingozi ezisongela izindawo eziphilayo yilokho ososayensi abakubiza ngokuthi izimbangi zokuguquka komhlaba, okuyisifundo sendlela iplanethi yomhlaba, njengesimiso, esiguquka ngayo ngokusebenzisana kwazo zonke izinto phakathi kwemisebenzi yabantu nezinye izinqubo zokwenyama, zekhemikhali nezobiological.

Kwesigaba sencwadi yakamuva, abacwaningi bahlole ukuthi kungakanani ucwaningo oluyenziwa eNingizimu Afrika ngokuqeda izilwane nezimila ezingaphandle, lapho izinhlobo zezitshalo noma izilwane zifakwa endaweni entsha lapho zikhula khona, zizimisele futhi zingazeonakalise ezinye izinhlobo ezizungezile noma imvelo.
Baphethe futhi ngocwaningo lokuthi lo mshayeli uqondana kanjani nabanye abashayeli.
Bekubheka izincwadi zocwaningo ezinyatheliswe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 kwedatha bese ye-“Web of Science”, bathole izifundo ezifanele ezingama-1149.

Ukubuyekezwa kwabo kwemisebenzi yocwaningo kwakhombisa ukuthi ucwaningo olusekelwe ezweni (olwasemhlabeni) lugxile kakhulu ekuthuthukeni kwendawo yokuhlala, kuyilapho ucwaningo lwamanzi amnandi lugxile ekungcoliseni, kanti ucwaningo lolwandle ne-estuary lubukele kakhulu ukukhahlela ngokweqile.
Baphethe futhi ukuthi izimpawu ezibhalwe kahle emhlabeni wonke ukuthi zithinta ukwahlukahluka kwemvelo noma izinsizakalo ze-ecosystem, azibhalwanga kahle ekuhloleni kwendawo yaseNingizimu Afrika.
Isibonelo, bathole kuphela izincwadi eziyi-5 ezibuka ukwanda kokubila kolwandle, okuyaphula izinhlangano zokudla futhi olimaza impilo yolwandle.
Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba ikhabhoni dayoksayidi elikhulu emoyeni, evela emisebenzini yabantu njengokushisa amalahle, lixazululeka emanzini olwandle.
Ukushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala, njengomlilo noma ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, kuholela ekukhuleni kwezinhlobo ezingena ngokungemthetho.
Bathe bathi ikhabhoni dayoksayidi ikhuphuke cishe ngamaphesenti angu-40, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi idala izimo ezinhle zokukhula kwemifino yasezweni langaphandle.
Kepha, kunocwaningo oluncane kakhulu oluenziwe kule ndaba eNingizimu Afrika.
Bathole amaphepha angu-21 abheka indlela abashayeli abahlukene abaxhumana ngayo.
Iningi lalezi zazigxile ekuxhumaniseni izinguquko zezindawo zokuhlala nezinhlobo ezihlaselayo.
Kodwa-ke, amaphepha ambalwa kakhulu abhekile kubashayeli abangu-3 noma ngaphezulu ngesikhathi esifanayo.
Ababhali bathi lokhu kusikisela ukuthi ucwaningo olwengeziwe mayelana nendlela abashayeli bokuhluka kwemvelo abaxhumana ngayo ukuze bathinte izinhlelo zekhaya kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika.

Ababhali baseNingizimu Afrika bayavuma ukuthi kuyoba nzima ukuthuthukisa umbono ophelele wokuthi abashayeli bezinguquko zomhlaba banxibelelana kanjani eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa bathi ucwaningo lwendawo olukhona ngezinhlobo ezihlaselayo selungase luqondise izifundo kule ndawo eyingozi.
Izici ze-edaphic ezilawula izinto eziphilayo zomhlabathi kanye nokugcinwa kwe-C ehlathini laseMiombo, eZambia.
Izinto eziphilayo zomhlabathi (SOM) iyisithako esiyinhloko sokukhiqiza kwamahlathi kanye nesitoko se-carbon ephilayo yomhlabathi.

Kodwa-ke, kuluncane olukwaziwayo mayelana nokuhlukahluka kwe-SOM ne-C ehlathini laseMiombo, eliyisiko-mfumo elikhulu ehlathini lase-Afrika esingaphansi kweSahara futhi libalulekile ezindleleni ze-REDD+.
Kulesifundo, izici ezingu-9 zomhlabathi zilinganiselwe futhi zasetshenziswa ukuhlaziya ukungafani kwe-SOM ezindaweni zasehlathini laseMiombo ezinezakhiwo ezahlukene zezihlahla eLuanshya, eZambia.
Okutholakele kukhombise ukuguquguquka okukhulu kwesitoko se-SOM emazingeni ahlukene omhlabathi:
Ama-36.67 kuya ku-113.89 Mg ha-1 kubunzima obu-0–10 cm, ama-28.67 kuya ku-79.56 Mg ha-1 kubunzima obu-10–20 cm, nama-31.89 kuya ku-98.56 Mg ha-1 kubunzima obu-20–30 cm.

Lezi zindinganiso ze-SOM ekujuleni okuhlukene nazo zashintshashintsha phakathi kwama-miombo woodland amasayithi ezigaba ezahlukene zokulandelana, ikakhulukazi ukuthi izindawo ezazibuthwe yokuhlanzwa kwemithi yakamuva zazinokuqukethwe kwe-SOM okuphezulu kunokulinganiselwe ngaphezulu kwesendlalelo (0–10 cm: +5.57%; 10–20 cm: +4.20%; 20–30 cm: +4.30%).

Uhlalutyo oluhambisanayo oluqondile (CCA) lubonakalisile ukuthi izici ezibaluleke kakhulu zemvelo eziphazamisa i-SOM kwakuwukuncishiswa kwehlathi ngokuhlanzwa, kanye nokuqukethwe kobumba emhlabathini.

Ucwaningo lolu lubonisa ukuthi i-CCA ingasetshenziswa ukubonisa ukubaluleka okulinganiselwe kwezinyathelo ezahlukene zokukhula kwehlathi njengomsebenzi wezindlela zokuphatha, kanye nezici ze-edaphic, ekuqondeni okuqukethwe kwe-SOM yomhlabathi we-miombo.

Imiphumela yalesi sifundo ibaluleke kakhulu ekunqobeni amasu wamanje we-REDD+ wokutshala izimithi nokulawula amagquma ezimithi, aqondiswe ekwandiseni amasitoke ekhabhoni ehlathini lase-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara.
Sithi ososayensi abafunda amahlathi aseZambia, ukugunda izimithi ngokucophelela kuyaqeda ukulungisa umhlabathi.
Abacwaningi bathi izindawo ezicwiliwe zasehlathini kanye nezinhlabathi eziphezulu ehlathini laseZambia zazinento eningi ephilayo, okusho ukuthi umhlabathi ukhulu.
Kubalulekile ukuqonda ikhwalithi yomhlabathi e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara ngoba ithonya kakhulu indlela izitshalo nezihlahla ezikhula ngayo.
Uluhlaza lunenutriyenti ezahlukene, futhi izinto eziphilayo nezilimo yizona ezibaluleke kakhulu ekusizeni izitshalo ukuba zikhule kahle.
Izinto eziphilayo yizinto ezisemhlabathini ezivela esaleni sezitshalo nezilwane ezifile.
Ngaphezulu kwengxenye (58%) yento ephilayo iyikhabhoni nje, bese okusele yimanzi namanye amaminerali.
Uluhlaza olunezinhlanzi ezinengi, futhi ngakho-ke unekhaboni, lugcina amanzi isikhathi eside futhi lunezinye izondlo eziningi.
Ososayensi abanawo ulwazi oluningi ngezinguquko zezinto eziphilayo nekhaboni ezingosini zase-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara, ngisho noma ziyibalulekile ekukhuleni kwemifino nemithi.
Kulesifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuthola ukuthi indaba yempahla ephilayo yomhlabathi ehlathini ishintshile kanjani, nokuthi yini ebeka inani.
Benze ucwaningo lwabo ehlathini eZambia.
Baqoqe amasampula omhlabathi phezulu (0-10 cm), phakathi (10-20 cm), nasezindaweni ezijulile (20-30 cm), nakwezinye izindawo ezahlukene zasehlathini.
Abacwaningi base bebahlola ithaka elabhorethri ukuhlola ukuthi linalo malini udaba oluphilayo.
Ilaboratri yi-indawo lapho ososayensi benza khona ukuhlola nokuhlola, ngokuvamile basebenzisa imishini enembile yokulinganisa izinto ezithile.
Baphinda babhala phansi ezinye izimfanelo zomhlabathi njengohlobo lwawo, ngokwesibonelo oluhlaza noma olufana nodongwe.
Imiphumela yabo yakhombisa ukuthi inani le-organic matter lahluka kakhulu phakathi kwezindawo ezihlukene, naphakathi kokujula okuhlukene.
Uluhla lwezwe oluphezulu lwalunamazinga aphezulu kakhulu ezinto eziphilayo ezafinyelela kuma-milligrams angu-114 (mg) ngehektha, kulandela ubukhulu bomhlabathi (cishe ama-100 mg ngehektha).
Uluhla lwezwe oluphakathi lwalunobuningi obuncane obufinyelela ku-80 mg ngehektha.
Abacwaningi bathi izindawo ehlathini ezazisanda kuhlanzwa zazinento eningi ephilayo kunendawo ezingakahlanzwa.
Baphinde baphakamise ukuthi ukuthungatha izimithi ehlathini, ngokuphathwa okucophelelayo, kungase khulisa izinto eziphilayo zomhlabathi.

Abacwaningi baphawula futhi ukuthi umbala womhlabathi washintsha ukusuka obumnyama obusundu (umhlabathi ophezulu) uya kobusundu obukhanyayo (umhlabathi ojulile), nokuthi imihlabathi yethanga nelesihlalo yayinento eningi yezinto eziphilayo.
Izindawo ehlathini ezazivulekele ukukhanya kwelanga zazinamahlathi amakhulu amadala, kanye nezinto eziphilayo eziningi.
Abacwaningi, ababehlala eZambia naseNingizimu Afrika, bathi izindlela zabo zingaguqulwa abanye ukuhlola ikhwalithi yomhlabathi ezindaweni ezihlukene nasemazingeni ahlukene.
Ukuthuthukisa Ukukhiqizwa Kwekheshi Nokukhiqiza Ngokusebenzisa Indlela Yezinkundla Zokwakha Izinto Ezintsha Zabantu Abathintekayo e-Ethiopia
I-Chickpea (Cicer arietinum L.) yiyona ingxenyekazi yokudla ebalulekile yesithathu kokubili ngendawo kanye nokukhiqizwa ngemuva kwamabhinca avamile namabhinca e-faba e-Ethiopia.
Kodwa-ke, ukukhiqiza komkhiqizo kwakuncane kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa namandla awo ngenxa yokungasetshenziswa kwezinhlobo ezithuthukisiwe nezindlela ezidalwe yisikhungo socwaningo.

Ukuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe nobuhlobene nocwaningo, i-National Chickpea Stakeholders Innovation Platform yasungulwa ngo-2013 enenjongo yokubuthana ngezinhlangano ezahlukene ezisebenza ochungechungeni lokukhiqiza ukuze kuhlonishwe inselele ezinkulu futhi kutholakale izixazululo ezizosetshenziswa ngemizamo ehlangene.
I-platform ibonile ukushoda kwembewu njengesiqondisi esikhulu kule nsimu.
Le nkinga iye yakhonjiswa ngokwakha amaqembu abalimi abakhiqiza imbewu ngosizo lwabalingani be-R&D futhi njengamanje yibona abahlinzeki abakhulu ezweni lonke.
Behlangana, leli qonga liqinisile umzamo wokwandisa futhi laqalisa ukusakazwa kwezobuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe kubalimi abaningi.
Ngenxa yalokho, ukukhiqiza komkhiqizo wabalimi abayizibonelo kwanda kakhulu kane, futhi ukukhiqiza kwesizwe kuphindwe kabili kuya ku-2 ton ha−1 kuleli khulu leminyaka eledlule.
Leli qonga liphinde lasebenza ekulungiseni ukufinyelela emakethe futhi muva nje i-chickpea ijoyine imakethe ye-Ethiopian Commodity Exchange.
Ngokubaqaphela amathuba amakhulu okukhula kwesitshalo, leli qembu lizama ukuqinisa ngokwengeziwe ukungenelela futhi liqoqe amathuba.
Indlela i-Ethiopia eyandisa ngayo ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda.

Abacwaningi bachaze ukuthi i-Ethiopia yakhuphula ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abalimi banokufinyelela ezimbini ezithuthukisiwe kanye nokuqeqeshwa ngezindlela zokulima ezithuthukisiwe.
Isikhuphu luhlobo lokudla olufana nebhinca oluhlwanyelwa kakhulu e-Ethiopia.
Iningi lemikhiqizo yezwe liyakhishwa nakwamanye amazwe.
Eminyakeni eminingi edlule, abantu abaningi baqaphela ukuthi abalimi bangakhiqiza amantongomane amaningi uma besebenzisa imbewu eyenziwe ngcono ezohlala iphila izinambuzane nezifo.
Incwadi yakamuva ichaza ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda ase-Ethiopia kuye kwanda kusukela kulokho kuqondwa.
Ababhali bathi ngo-2013, i-Ethiopia yakha i-“National Chickpea Stakeholders Innovation Platform” eyaxoxa ngezinkinga ekukhiqizweni kwe-chickpea futhi yaveza izixazululo.
I-platform ifana nenhlangano.
Ipulatifomu yayifaka abacwaningi, uMnyango wezoLimo wase-Ethiopia, amaqembu abalimi kanye nezinhlangano, abenzi bokudla, abakhiqizi bembewu, nabalingani bokuthumela kwamanye amazwe.
Ababhali bathi isiteji sabona ukushoda kwembewu njengesinye sezinselelo ezinkulu, bese bakha izinhlangano zokunikeza imbewu kulo lonke izwe.
Lokhu kushintsha kwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda kabili kwaze kwaba yiyithoni ezimbili ngehektha.
Omunye umsebenzi ababewubone kwakuwukuntuleka kokukhulu kwemikhiqizo.
Bafundise abalimi ngezindlela zokukhiqiza ezingcono, njengokusebenzisa umanyolo ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomhlabathi.
Baphawule futhi ukuthi abalimi bahlupheka ukulawula ukhula.
Ngakho-ke banike abafama imbewu yeqhwa elihluma kahle ngisho noma lihlatshelwe ngezidakamizwa zezinhlanga, ezingamakhemikhali abafama abawasebenzisayo ukulawula ukhula noma izitshalo ezingafuneki.
Ababhali bathi i-platform yenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abalimi bafundiswe ukuze bakhulise ulwazi lwabo ngokukhiqizwa kwamaqhawe.
Abalimi nabo babekhona emicimbini lapho bebelingana khona ulwazi namava abo.
Ababhali bathi i-platform ihlanganisa abalimi nabathengi, kanye nabakhiqizi bembewu nalabo ababophekile ekuthengeni nasekusabalaliseni imbewu kubalimi.
I-platform ibuye yakha futhi yaqeqesha amaqembu abesifazane nabasha ekukhiqizeni i-chickpea.
Baphinde bakhuthaza abesifazane nabasha ukuba bahlanganyele ekukhiqizweni kwembewu.
Ababhali bathi naphezu kokuthi kufezwe okuningi, kusasekhona ukushoda kwembewu yebhinya.
Baphinda bathi i-platforming ingathola okwengeziwe uma ngabe inezinsiza zokuthi ihlangane njalo.
Bacebisa ukuthi uMnyango wezoLimo wase-Ethiopia nabacwaningi kufanele basekele isiteji ngemali ukuze singaweli.
Baphakamise futhi ukuthuthukiswa kokulingana kwamaqanda kanye nendlela okuqondwa ngayo ingozi yokukhiqiza amaqanda, njengezifo.
Ekugcineni, ababhali bacela imbewu ethuthukisiwe kakhulu ezizoba lula ukuvunwa ngemishini, futhi ezingathinteki yizidakamizwa zezinhlanga.
Uhlobo oluhlukile lwe-SARS-CoV-2 lineage A (A.23.1) olunezinguquko ze-spike luvele futhi lubusa ubhubhane lwamanje lwase-Uganda.
Ukubhekwa kwe-genome ye-SARS-CoV-2 e-Uganda kunikeza ithuba lokwenza incazelo egxile ekuthuthukeni kwe-virus ezweni elincane lase-Afrika eseMpumalanga elingenayo ulwandle.

Lapha sibonisa ushintsho lwamuva olukhona ekuhambeni kwesifo kule ndawo, ngohlobo olusha oluvela i-A.23 oluguqukela ku-A.23.1 oluqondisa manje amacala ase-Uganda futhi selusakazeke kwamanye amazwe angu-26.
Nakuba izinguquko eziqondile ku-A.23.1 njengoba iziqondanise zihlukile kunalokho okuseziguqukeni ezikhathazayo (VOC), ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kubonisa ukuhlangana kusethi efanayo yamaprotheni.

Isifunda sokukodwa kwe-spike protein ye-A.23.1 siqoqele ukuguquka okufana nokuningi kokuguquka okubonwayo kwi-VOC okuhlanganisa ukuguquka endaweni engu-613, ukuguquka endaweni yokuhlukanisa i-furin okwandisa i-motif ye-amino acid esiqinile, kanye nokuguquka okuningi esizindeni se-N-terminal esenza imisebenzi yokulwa nezifo.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-A.23.1 lineage iqukethe izinguquko eziprotheni ezingaphandle kwe-spike ezibuye zibonwe kwezinye i-VOC (i-nsp6, i-ORF8 ne-ORF9).

Uthonyo lwezokwelapha lwe-A.23.1 variant alucaci kalula, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokulandelela ngokucophelela le variant, kanye nokulinganisa ngokushesha imiphumela yokuguqulwa kwe-spike protein ekusebenzeni kwe-vaccine.
Abacwaningi babika ngokuthuthuka kwe-SARS-CoV-2 e-Uganda.
Ngo-2021, abacwaningi babike ukuthi uhlobo olusha lwe-SARS-CoV-2, i-virus ebangela i-Covid-19, luvelele e-Uganda futhi lwase lwesabekela kwamanye amazwe angu-26.
Bayibize leli-variant ngokuthi “A.23.1”, bathi inezinguquko eziningi ezifanayo kumaphrotheni abacwaningi abaye babona kwezinye izinhlobo ezibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele ngalesi sikhathi.
Oososayensi balandelela indlela izinhlobo ze-coronavirus eziyishintshayo ukuze bakwazi ukuqonda kangcono ukuthi izigqoko zisebenza kangcono kanjani ezinhlotsheni ezintsha.
I-Covid-19 ibulele abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele.
Enqubweni eyaziwa ngokuthi ukubhekwa kwe-genome, ososayensi balandela indlela i-genetics namaprotheni e-virus ashintsha ngayo njengoba isakazeka.
Bayasebenzisa lolu lwazi ukulawula isifo nokuqondisa ukuthuthukiswa kwe-vaccine.
Isibonelo, ngokuqonda ubukhulu bephrotheni ze-spike ze-virus, abacwaningi bangaklama ama-vaccine ahlanganisa kangcono leziphrotheni ukuze kuvimbelwe i-virus ukungena ezicellini zabantu.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi babheke ngokukhethekile indlela i-SARS-CoV-2 eyayithuthuka ngayo e-Uganda.
Abacwaningi baqonde uhlu lwe-genetic lwesivivirus emasampuleni okutholakele ku-COVID-19 athathwe kulo lonke elase-Uganda.

Basebenzise isofthiwe yekhompyutha ukuze balandele umlando (noma umlando womndeni) wohlobo olusha abalubona ngale ndlela (oluthiwa yi-A.23.1), futhi bakwazi ukubona ukuthi uhlobo luhambisana kanjani nomuthi womndeni we-SARS-CoV-2.
Imiphumela yabo yakhombisa ukuthi uhlobo lwe-A.23.1 luye lwathuthuka muva nje kwenye uhlobo oluthiwa yi-A.23, futhi lwafunyanwa ku-90% yazo zonke izibonelo ezithathelwe.
Ngamanye amazwi, bekuyibusayo emasampuleni ase-Uganda kusukela ngo-Okthoba 2020.
Baphethe futhi ukuthi uhlobo lwe-A.23.1 lwaluna ukuguqulwa okuningi eprotheni ye-spike okufana nokuguqulwa okubonwe kwezinye izinhlobo ezibalulekile.
Lezi zinguquko cishe zenza uhlobo oluhlukile ludluliseke kalula (luyasakazeka ngokushesha), futhi lube nokumelana okuqine kakhulu neziqephu zokugcoba kanye nokwelashwa.
Lolu cwaningo lwenza igalelo emizamweni eqhubekayo yokulandelana kwe-SARS-CoV-2 ehlukahlukene emhlabeni jikelele.
Imiphumela iyakwengeza ebufakazini obukhula bokuthi i-SARS-CoV-2 ithuthuka ngokushesha njengoba isakazeka iphethe abantu abaningi futhi iphikisane neziqephu.
Kodwa-ke, ucwaningo olwengeziwe luyadingeka ukuqonda ukuthi yini ngempela imiphumela noma imisebenzi yokuguqulwa kwe-spike protein e-A.23.1 variant.
Abacwaningi bayekazelela ukuqapha okwengeziwe kwe-genomic ukuze kusisize siqonde ukuthi izinhlobo ze-virus ziphendula kanjani ezibulaleni zezifo ezitholakala e-Uganda nakwamanye amazwe.
Bathi futhi ukuqapha uhambo lwamazwe ngamazwe kubalulekile ukuze abacwaningi baqonde kangcono indlela i-virus esakazeka ngayo endaweni.

Izifundo Zezimo Zokuchaza Izizathu Nezimpawu Zokuhlukunyezwa/Ukusika Kwamalungu Okwasebenzeni Kwabesifazane e-Indonesia, e-Ethiopia nase-Kenya
Ukugqoka/ukulimaza izitho zangasese zabesifazane kuyindlela yokudabula yendabuko elimaza amalungelo abesifazane futhi inezingozi empilweni.
Le ncwadi ibonisa izizathu nezimo zokusikwa kwezilwane zangasese zabesifazane (FGM/C) ezindaweni ezithile zamazwe amathathu – i-Indonesia, i-Ethiopia ne-Kenya.

Imininingwane iqoqwe ngesifundo semindeni nentsha (eneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 no-24) kanye nezingxoxo zamaqembu okuqondisisa, izingxoxo eziqondile kanye nezingxoxo zabantu abanolwazi olukhulu phakathi kwentsha nabantu abathintekayo emphakathini ngo-2016 no-2017.
Kwenziwe izihloko zezibalo ne-thematic content analysis.

Imiphumela yocwaningo iqinisekisa ezinye zezizathu ze-FGM/C ezibhalwe yiwo amanye ucwaningo, iphawula ukuthi lezi zizathu zixhunyanisene kakhulu, futhi izindinganiso zobulili yiyona yona eholela kuzo.
Kuzo zonke izimo ezintathu, lezizizathu ziqhuba ukuguqulwa kwamizimba yabesifazane ukuze kuvele umzimba “oqhubekile” owamukelwa yi-status quo yobudlelwano bobuqaba.
Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube ‘umzimba ohlanzekile’ e-Indonesia, ‘umzimba othobekile’ e-Ethiopia kanye ‘nomzimba omdala’ e-Kenya.
Abasebenzi bezempilo nabazali badlala indima ebalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo mayelana ne-FGM/C kuzo zonke izindawo.
EKhenya, ikakhulukazi, abesifazane abasebasha baxoxa ngendima yabo ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphathelene ne-FGM/C njengoba sebemdala ngesikhathi sokusoka.

Ucwaningo lubonisa ukuthi izimo zomthetho nomphakathi ezihlukahlukene kuyo yonke indawo ziletha izinguquko ensimini yomkhuba we-FGM/C, okuholela ekwelashweni kwe-FGM/C e-Indonesia, ekuthotshisweni kweminyaka yokusika amantombazane eKenya, nasekwenzeni komkhuba we-FGM/C ngasese e-Ethiopia.
Lezi zimo ezintathu zibonisa ukwahluka okukhulu endleleni yokwenza i-FGM/C kanye nencazelo yomphakathi eyihlanganisayo kubantu abasebasha nabantu basemakhaya abo.
Kunendingeko yokuhlola ngokujulile indima yabazali ekwenzeni izinqumo.

Ngenxa yezixhumani phakathi kwabashayeli abahlukene be-FGM/C kuwo wonke umongo, ucwaningo luphetha ngokuthi izindlela ezifanele umongo kufanele zithathwe yizinhlelo zokusebenzelana ukuze kudalwe ushintsho oluhlala njalo.
Ukuyeka ukusoka kwabesifazane, okokuqala kudingeka siqonde ukuthi kungani kwenzeka.

Ukusithwa kwesitho sobulili sesifazane, umkhuba lapho izingxenye zezitho zokuzala zesifazane zisiqoshwa noma zisuswa khona, kusawenziwa ngokungekho emthethwini noma ngasese emazweni afana neKenya, i-Ethiopia ne-Indonesia.
Abacwaningi bathi ukuqonda ukuthi kungani kwenzeka kuyisihluthulelo sokuyeka lesi siko elilimaza, nokuvimbela izinkinga zempilo nezingqondo abesifazane abazibhekana nazo ngenxa yalokho.
Ezingxenyeni zase-Afrika nase-Asia, ukunqunyulwa kwesitho sobulili sesifazane (FGM), okuthi ngezinye izikhathi kubizwe ngokuthi ‘ukusoka kwabesifazane’, kusawenziwa kakhulu.

Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ngamanga ukuthi i-FGM iyadingeka ukuze kube nokuhlanzeka okuhle noma ukuze bagcine abesifazane behloniphekile (bengabi nazinto zokuzidla futhi bathobekile), futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bazokwazi ukuba nezingane.
Ngokwesibonakaliso sesayensi, ukusoka kwabesifazane akudingeki kunoma yikuphi kula.

Kodwa-ke, ezimweni eziningi, abantwana abaye baphathwa yi-FGM baphela bebenobungezi bezempilo kamuva ekuphileni, njengezifo ezilimazayo, ubunzima bokuthamba (ukuphuma kwamanzi), nezingqinamba zempilo yengqondo.
Ngenxa yokuthi leyo ndlela yokwenza izinto inonya kakhulu futhi iphula amalungelo abantu besifazane, amazwe amaningi ayenze ingasekho emthethweni, kodwa abantu basaphikelela ngasese.
Kulesifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuqonda okwengeziwe ngokuthi kungani i-FGM yenzeka emazweni ahlukene, nokuthi abantu bakholelwa ini ngale nqubo.
Ngakho-ke, baqoqe ulwazi mayelana nokuhlatshwa kwesikhumba kwabesifazane eKenya, e-Ethiopia nase-Indonesia.

Kulo lonke izwe, abacwaningi bakhulume nabantu ngaleli qhekeza, kuhlanganise abazali, intsha, abaholi besiko, abasebenzi bezempilo, nabenza ukusoka (abesifazane abadala ababekade benza ukusoka kwabesifazane kubantwana abesifazane).
Kwezinye izimo, babexoxa nabantu laba ngabanye, kodwa bakhulume neqembu labantu, kuhlanganise nabantu abadala abasebancane nabasakhulayo, ababehlupheke yi-FGM.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi izizathu zokugoqa i-FGM, indlela okwenziwa ngayo, nezimfundiso ngale nqubo, zazingefani kuwo wonke amazwe.
Baphinda bathola ukuthi abantu abaningi basaphikelela kukho, ngisho nasezindaweni lapho bekungekho emthethweni khona.

Isibonelo, e-Indonesia, abantu abadala abasebenza ngokuzalwa kwabantwana basebenzisa ummese noma unaliti ukunquma ingxenye yeklitorisi (umzimba obhekene kakhulu nenjabulo yobulili kwabesifazane) uma intombazanyana ineminyaka engama-40 ubudala.
Abantu bakholelwa ukuthi lokhu kusiza ‘ukususa ubungcolile’ nokuthi kubalulekile ngezizathu zenkolo.
ENase-Etiopia, ukuqothulwa kwesikhumba kwaba khona ngisho nangaphambili, ngezinye izikhathi lapho izingane zineminyaka engu-7 kuphela.

Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abantu lapho bakholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi intombazane izobe ‘yinkosikazi enhle’ ngolunye usuku, nokuthi izobe ilalela, futhi ingabi nentukuthelo kumyeni wayo.
Abantu abaningi bakholelwa nokuthi ukusoka kwabesifazane kwenza ukubeletha kube lula, kodwa empeleni kungenza kube nzima ukubeletha.
Okwamanje eKenya, ukusoka kwakubonisa ukuthi intombazane ifinyelele ubufazi, futhi kwakwenzeka kamuva ekuphileni, lapho isiyintshabalala.

Kodwa-ke, kwezinye izimo, bathole ukuthi amantombazane angagqashulwa eneminyaka engu-8 ubudala, futhi amantombazane amaningi agcine ekhulelwe esemncane, ngoba ayebhekwa njengokwanele ukuba nobulili ngemuva kokugqashulwa.
Abacwaningi bathi okutholakele kwabo kubonisa ukuthi kunezizathu eziningi ezihlukene ezenza ukuba ukusoka kwabesifazane kusekhona.
Njengoba imithetho nemibono yomphakathi ishintsha, indlela nendawo lapho kwenziwa khona nayo iyashintsha.
Ngokwesibonelo, abazali bangazama ukuyenza ngasese ngisho noma kungekho emthethweni, ngoba bacabanga ukuthi kuyadingeka ukuthi indodakazi yabo ibe nempilo enhle noma ithole umyeni omuhle.

Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ngenxa yokuthi ukusoka kwabesifazane akuvumelekile kwezinye izindawo, ucwaningo lalo mbandela lungaba nzima, futhi abantu bangase bangabi namanga ngaso sonke isikhathi ngale ndaba.

Kusasa, ngaphezu kokwenza kube ngokungekho emthethweni, abacwaningi bathi ohulumeni neziphathimandla zezempilo kufanele baqonde ukuyeka ukwenziwa kwe-FGM ngokubhekana nemingcele engamanga abantu abayinayo ngale nqubo nokubafundisa ngezingozi zayo.

Ucwaningo lolu lwaluyisivumelwano phakathi kwesayensi evela e-Ethiopia, e-Indonesia nase-Netherlands, futhi luyinxenye yephrojekthi enkulu, ebizwa nge-'Yes I Do programme', ehlose ukunciphisa ukukhulelwa kwentsha, umshado wabantwana kanye ne-FGM.

Izitshalo ezikhula unyaka nonyaka zazenza ingxenye enkulu yezinhlobo ezilimiwe (83%), kuyilapho izitshalo ezikhula unyaka ngamunye zazenza ingxenye eseleyo (17%).

Kusuka kulezi zitshalo ezirekhodiwe, ezingu-140 (58.6%) zazizinhlobo ezisetshenziswa ezisetshenzisweni zemvelo, ezingu-84 (35%) izitshalo zokudla, ezingu-83 (34.7%) izinhlobo zezitshalo zokwelapha, ezingu-39 (16.3%) izinhlobo zokudla kwezilwane, ezingu-57 (23.8%) izitshalo ezisetshenziswa ezinto, ezingu-60 (25%) izinhlobo zezinkuni zokushisa, ezingu-50 (21%) izitshalo ezisetshenziswa ngokwentlalo kanye ne-1 (0.4%) enenkani.
Ukuhlaziywa okuqondile kwamathethri kukhombisile ukuthi i-Cordia Africana itholakala njengomkhiqizo obalulekile ngokwamasiko endaweni, futhi usongelwe kakhulu, kulandela i-Ficus sur.
Inkambo yase-Afrika ebaluleke kakhulu yayisetshenziswa ekwakheni, kanti inani elikhulu lalisetshenziswa kwelapha.
I-Sorensen index yokufana kwaba ngu-64% yezindawo ezahlolwa yayingaphansi kuka-0.5.
Umphumela ubonise ukuthi amagadini asemakhaya yizinhlelo zokukhiqiza eziningi, zesikhathi eside.
Ukuphepha kokudla nokugcinwa kobuningi bezinhlobo zemvelo kuqhubeka noxhaswe yilwazi lesiko labantu bezizwe elixhunyaniswe nemihlambi yabo yasekhaya.

Ukufana okuncane/ukwahlukahluka okukhulu kwezinhlobo endaweni phakathi kwama-kebele kubonise ukuthi kwakukhona ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezinhlobo lokhu kwakubangelwa yizimo ezahlukene ze-agroecological phakathi kwama-kebele.
Imihlambi yase-Ethiopia isekela ukuphepha kokudla nokugcinwa kwemvelo.
Abacwaningi bathi abantu abaningi base-Ethiopia bayalima ukudla, izitshalo zokuhlobisa, izitshalo zokwelapha nezitshalo zokudla izilwane, isithunzi noma ukuvikela emagadini abo.
Bahlolisise lezi zihlahla ukuze babone ukuthi zibaluleke kangakanani ekuqinisekiseni ukuphepha kokudla nasekusizeni ukulondoloza imvelo.
Izindawo ezahlukene emhlabeni lonke zigcina izitshalo zokudla, ukuze zenze imali nakwezinye izinjongo zezenhlalo.
Ama-gardens nawo avikele izitshalo ezibalulekile ezivame ukungabikho noma ezinyamalala kwezinye izindawo.
ENase-Etiyopiya, akukho ucwaningo oluningi oluye lwenziwa ngalokho umphakathi ulikhihla ngempela emisebeni yawo.
Kulesifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuhlola izitshalo abantu baseGozamin, eNyakatho-Ntshonalanga ye-Ethiopia, ababezihlwanyela emagadini abo nalokho ababelizisebenzisela khona.
Bahlonze futhi babala izitshalo emagadini angu-357 kule ndawo.
Baphethisise futhi umphakathi ngalokho abakusebenzisela khona izitshalo.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi wonke amagadini eGozamin ayenqaba ukuba ngaphezu kwehektha ngobukhulu.
Baqoqe futhi bahlonza izitshalo ezahlukene ezingu-238.
Iningi (83%) lezitshalo libiwe unyaka wonke, futhi ziningi ezimbalwa (17%) ezaziyizikhathi zesizini.
Imiphumela yabo yakhombisa ukuthi umphakathi wawusebenzisa izitshalo ekudleni, kwelapha, ekwakheni, ekudleni kwezilwane (ukudla kwezilwane), nakwezinye izindlela zokusebenzisa ngamasiko.
Izitshalo eziningi zazisebenza ngezinjongo ezingaphezu kwesisodwa.

Isibonelo, isibonelo, umuthi omkhulu onamagqabi amakhulu aseNyakatho ungase usetshenziswe kwelokwelapha, ukulungisa, ukondla izilwane, ukumthunzi, ukupakisha nokuqeda, kanye nezinye izisetshenziswa zesiko.
Ngaphezulu kwengxenye (59%) yemifino yayisetshenziswa ngezinjongo zemvelo njengokufakwa kwezilingo, izihlahla, isithunzi nokuhlobisa.
Abacwaningi bathi lokhu kusize ekuvikeleni imvelo.
Izitshalo zokufaka isivikelo nazo zisize ekulondeni imikhiqizo yasemapulazini.
Ngaphezu kwesithathu (35%) zezitshalo zakhuliselwa ukudla, njengokudla okunjengokuthi izithelo, imifino, izitshalo zokudla kanye nezinongo.
Kodwa-ke bathi amagadini aseleleliyo ayingxenye enkulu ahlinzeka ngezithelo.

Abacwaningi bathi u-35% wemifino yayisetshenziswa njengalokho kwelapho lesintu lokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu nezilwane, kanti u-21% yayisetshenziswa emikhosini nasezintweni zenkolo, ukubhema, amafutha, nokubhaka.
Ezinye izitshalo (17%) zasetshenziswa njengokudla kwezilwane ezifuywayo, izinkomo, izimvu, neembongolo.
Abanye (24%) basebenzisa njengezinto zokwakha, ukwenza amathuluzi okusebenza ensimini, ukumboza imindeni kanye nokwenza izintambo.
Njengoba iningi labantu basemakhaya kubikwe ukuthi basebenzisa imithi yokukhaphela, u-25% wezitshalo zasetshenziswa ngalokho.
Abacwaningi bathi yilokhu kuphela (0.4%) okukhulunywe ngakho ngenhloso yokubulala ngenhlalakanu.
Baphinda bathi indlela izitshalo ezazisabalala ngayo kule ndawo yayithonywe yizimo zemvelo, lokho abantu ababekufuna ukukudla, kanye nesimo sezimali somndeni nezidingo zebhizinisi.
Isibonelo, indawo ebizwa ngokuthi iWenka eyayinamanzi okunisela futhi isondele edolobheni elikhulu, yayinezitshalo eziningi futhi irekhode izitshalo ezahlukene ezingama-130.
Abantu baseWenka nabo babelima futhi banikeza izithelo nemifino emakethe yedolobha.
Ekugcineni, abacwaningi bathi abalimi abaningi babekhetha ukukhulisa izitshalo ezinokusetshenziswa okuningi.
Abacwaningi bathi imiphumela yabo iqinisekisile ukuthi impela abalimi bakhulise inani elikhulu lezinhlanga ezahlukene zezitshalo emagadini abo, futhi ngezinjongo ezahlukene.
Ngaphandle kokuthi laba bacwaningi bathole ukuthi abalimi abaningi bakhulise ama-herb, abanye abacwaningi bathi izihlahla zazivame kakhulu kule ndawo.
Abacwaningi balolu cwaningo babeqhelele emanyuvesi ase-Ethiopia.
